-- Verify: show individual moving averages correctly
WITH RECURSIVE date_series(sale_date) AS (
    SELECT DATE '2017-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sale_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_series
    WHERE sale_date < DATE '2018-08-29'
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
    WHERE pt.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
full_series AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.sale_date,
        COALESCE(daily.daily_sales, 0) as sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.sale_date) as day_num
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN daily_sales daily ON ds.sale_date = daily.sale_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM full_series
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE '2018-12-03' + (g * INTERVAL '1' DAY) as sale_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE '2018-12-03' + (g * INTERVAL '1' DAY)) as day_num,
        r.slope * ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE '2018-12-03' + (g * INTERVAL '1' DAY)) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM generate_series(0, 7) AS g(g)
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sale_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) as moving_avg
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2
    WHERE p.sale_date IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.sale_date
)
SELECT * FROM moving_averages ORDER BY sale_date

-- Full computation: predict toy sales for Dec 5-8, 2018 using linear regression,
-- compute 5-day symmetric moving averages, and sum them
WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales,
        CAST(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - DATE('2017-01-01') as days_since_start
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, days_since_start) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, days_since_start) as intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
dates AS (
    SELECT DATE('2018-12-03') as target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-04')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-05')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-06')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-07')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-08')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-09')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-10')
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        d.target_date,
        r.slope * (d.target_date - DATE('2017-01-01')) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM dates d, regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.target_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) as moving_avg_5day
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 ON p2.target_date BETWEEN p.target_date - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND p.target_date + INTERVAL '2' DAY
    WHERE p.target_date BETWEEN DATE('2018-12-05') AND DATE('2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.target_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) as sum_of_5day_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages

),
daily_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS sale_date,

  FROM orders o

  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

  WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
    AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
    AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
  GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
with_daynum AS (
  SELECT 
    dr.sale_date,
    COALESCE(ds.daily_sales, 0) AS daily_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dr.sale_date) AS day_num
  FROM date_range dr
  LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds ON dr.sale_date = ds.sale_date
  WHERE dr.sale_date >= '2017-01-01' AND dr.sale_date <= '2018-08-29'
),
regression AS (

    REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
    REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
  FROM with_daynum
),
all_dates_for_predictions AS (

  FROM (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, 730)) AS n)
),
all_with_daynum AS (

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ad.sale_date) AS day_num
  FROM all_dates_for_predictions ad

),
predicted AS (

    awd.sale_date,

target_dates AS (

  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-08'
),
moving_averages AS (

  JOIN predicted p1 ON p1.sale_date BETWEEN td.target_date - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND td.target_date + INTERVAL '2' DAY
  GROUP BY td.target_date

SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) AS sum_of_5day_moving_averages FROM moving_averages

WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT DATE('2017-01-01') + INTERVAL (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY 1) - 1) DAY as sale_date
    FROM generate_series(0, 605)
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.sale_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.sale_date) - 1 as day_number,
        COALESCE(d.daily_sales, 0) as daily_sales
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN daily_sales d ON ds.sale_date = d.sale_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_number) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_number) as intercept
    FROM combined
),
predicted_days AS (
    SELECT 
        pdn.day_number,
        r.slope * CAST(pdn.day_number AS DOUBLE) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM regression r
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (701), (702), (703), (704), (705), (706), (707), (708)) AS pdn(day_number)
),
target_days AS (
    SELECT unnest([703, 704, 705, 706]) as target_day
),
moving_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        t.target_day,
        AVG(p.predicted_sales) as moving_avg
    FROM target_days t
    JOIN predicted_days p ON p.day_number BETWEEN t.target_day - 2 AND t.target_day + 2
    GROUP BY t.target_day
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg) as sum_of_moving_averages
FROM moving_avgs

-- Final: sum of the four 5-day symmetric moving averages
WITH toy_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS sale_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_sales_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    WHERE pcat.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
daily_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL AS sale_date,
        COALESCE(ts.daily_sales_count, 0) AS sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL) AS day_number
    FROM (SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(0, 600)) AS n)
    LEFT JOIN toy_sales ts ON CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL = ts.sale_date
    WHERE CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL >= '2017-01-01' 
        AND CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL <= '2018-08-29'
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(sales, day_number) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(sales, day_number) AS intercept
    FROM daily_data
),
prediction_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST('2018-12-03' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL AS sale_date
    FROM (SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(0, 7)) AS n)
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.sale_date,
        r.slope * (702 + pd.pred_seq - 1) + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            pd.sale_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pd.sale_date) AS pred_seq
        FROM prediction_dates pd
    ) pd
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.sale_date AS center_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS moving_avg
    FROM predictions p1
    JOIN predictions p2 ON p2.sale_date BETWEEN p1.sale_date - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND p1.sale_date + INTERVAL 2 DAY
    WHERE p1.sale_date IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p1.sale_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg) AS sum_of_moving_averages FROM moving_averages

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) as day_num,
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
reg_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
prediction_days AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, 685)) as day_num
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.day_num,
        r.slope * p.day_num + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM prediction_days p
    CROSS JOIN reg_params r
    WHERE p.day_num >= 678 AND p.day_num <= 685
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE p.day_num
            WHEN 680 THEN DATE '2018-12-05'
            WHEN 681 THEN DATE '2018-12-06'
            WHEN 682 THEN DATE '2018-12-07'
            WHEN 683 THEN DATE '2018-12-08'
        END as target_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) as moving_avg
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2
    WHERE p.day_num IN (680, 681, 682, 683)
    GROUP BY p.day_num
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg) as sum_of_moving_averages FROM moving_averages

-- Final RFM analysis with customer_unique_id, showing average sales per order per segment
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
        op.payment_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
ref_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_ts) AS max_ts FROM delivered_orders
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT 
        d.customer_id,
        CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(d.order_ts), r.max_ts) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(d.payment_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders d
    CROSS JOIN ref_date r
    GROUP BY d.customer_id, r.max_ts
),
rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        cr.customer_id,
        cr.recency_days,
        cr.frequency,
        cr.monetary,
        ROUND(1.0 * cr.monetary / cr.frequency, 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cr.recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cr.frequency DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cr.monetary DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_rfm cr
    JOIN customers c ON cr.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
rfm_with_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_cell,
        CASE 
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
              OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    customer_count,
    avg_sales_per_order,
    avg_recency_days,
    avg_monetary,
    avg_frequency,
    rfm_cell_range
FROM (
    SELECT 
        rfm_segment,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
        ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days,
        ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_monetary,
        ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
        MIN(rfm_cell) || ' - ' || MAX(rfm_cell) AS rfm_cell_range
    FROM rfm_with_segment
    GROUP BY rfm_segment
) sub
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
        SUM(order_total) AS total_spend,
        SUM(order_total) / 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        last_purchase,
        order_count,
        total_spend,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        CAST(date_diff('day', CAST(last_purchase AS TIMESTAMP), CAST('2018-08-29 15:00:37' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS recency_days,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(last_purchase AS TIMESTAMP) DESC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_metrics
),
rfm_segmented AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        last_purchase,
        order_count,
        total_spend,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        recency_days,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_score,
        f_score + m_score AS fm_sum,
        CASE 
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(total_spend), 2) AS avg_total_spend,
    ROUND(AVG(order_count), 2) AS avg_order_count,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days
FROM rfm_segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

           TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as career_hr
    FROM batting 
    WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_id

max_vals AS (
    SELECT MAX(career_g) as max_g, MAX(career_r) as max_r, MAX(career_h) as max_h, MAX(career_hr) as max_hr
    FROM career_stats
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g as games_played,
           cs.career_r as runs,
           cs.career_h as hits,
           cs.career_hr as home_runs,
           CASE WHEN cs.career_g = mv.max_g THEN 'Games Played' END as category,
           CASE WHEN cs.career_g = mv.max_g THEN cs.career_g END as value
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_g = mv.max_g 
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g, cs.career_r, cs.career_h, cs.career_hr,
           'Runs', cs.career_r
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_r = mv.max_r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g, cs.career_r, cs.career_h, cs.career_hr,
           'Hits', cs.career_h
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_h = mv.max_h
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g, cs.career_r, cs.career_h, cs.career_hr,
           'Home Runs', cs.career_hr
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv

)

WITH airport_coords AS (
  SELECT 
    airport_code,
    city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS longitude,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flights_with_abakan AS (
  SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport,
         dep.longitude AS dep_lon, dep.latitude AS dep_lat,
         arr.longitude AS arr_lon, arr.latitude AS arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airport_coords dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airport_coords arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
  WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
)
SELECT MAX(
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POW(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
        COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
        POW(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
      )
    )
  ) AS max_distance_km
FROM flights_with_abakan

WITH abakan_routes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
  WHERE dep.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR arr.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
),
route_coords AS (
  SELECT ar.departure_airport, ar.arrival_airport
  FROM abakan_routes ar
  JOIN airports_data dep ON ar.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON ar.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT *,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH '(' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 1)) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lon,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH ')' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 2)) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lat,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH '(' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 1)) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lon,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH ')' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 2)) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lat
  FROM route_coords
  JOIN airports_data dep ON route_coords.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON route_coords.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
)
SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport,
       ROUND(6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
         POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
         COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
         POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
       )), 2) AS distance_km
FROM parsed

WITH route_distances AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        dep.airport_code AS dep_code,
        arr.airport_code AS arr_code,
        dep.city AS dep_city,
        arr.city AS arr_city,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lat,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lat
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
    WHERE dep.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR arr.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
        + COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180)
        * POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
    ))
)) AS max_distance_km
FROM route_distances

WITH parsed_coords AS (
    SELECT 
        rf.departure_airport,
        rf.arrival_airport,
        dep.coordinates::VARCHAR AS dep_coords,
        arr.coordinates::VARCHAR AS arr_coords
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport
        FROM flights f
        WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
    ) rf
    JOIN airports_data dep ON rf.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON rf.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
haversine AS (
    SELECT 
        2 * 6371 * ASIN(
            SQRT(
                POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN arr_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) - TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN dep_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE)) * PI() / 360), 2)
                + COS(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN dep_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180)
                * COS(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN arr_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180)
                * POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN arr_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) - TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN dep_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE)) * PI() / 360), 2)
            )
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM parsed_coords
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(MAX(distance_km)) AS INTEGER) AS max_distance_km
FROM haversine

WITH airport_info AS (
  SELECT 
    airport_code,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(TRY_CAST(city AS VARCHAR), '"en": "', 2), '"', 1) as city_en,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', 2), ',', 1)::DOUBLE as longitude,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 2), ')', 1)::DOUBLE as latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flight_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a1.city_en as from_city,
    a2.city_en as to_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POW(SIN(RADIANS(a2.latitude - a1.latitude) / 2), 2) +
      COS(RADIANS(a1.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(a2.latitude)) *
      POW(SIN(RADIANS(a2.longitude - a1.longitude) / 2), 2)
    )) as distance
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airport_info a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
  JOIN airport_info a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
  WHERE a1.city_en != a2.city_en
),
city_pair_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN from_city ELSE to_city END as city1,
    CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN to_city ELSE from_city END as city2,
    AVG(distance) as avg_distance
  FROM flight_distances
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
city_pair_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM city_pair_avg
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM city_pair_buckets
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as fewest_pair_count
FROM range_counts

WITH flight_data AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(dep.city, '""', '"') AS JSON)->>'en' as dep_city,
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(arr.city, '""', '"') AS JSON)->>'en' as arr_city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
flight_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    dep_city,
    arr_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
      POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
    )) as distance_km
  FROM flight_data
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    LEAST(dep_city, arr_city) as city1,
    GREATEST(dep_city, arr_city) as city2,
    distance_km
  FROM flight_distances
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance_km) as avg_distance
  FROM city_pairs
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_range AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-5000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-6000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM with_range
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT 
  distance_range,
  pair_count
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY pair_count ASC, distance_range ASC

  JOIN airports dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    LEAST(from_city, to_city) as city1,
    GREATEST(from_city, to_city) as city2,
    distance
  FROM flight_distances
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance) as avg_distance
  FROM city_pairs
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-1999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-2999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-3999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-4999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-5999'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
)
SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) as pair_count
FROM with_ranges
GROUP BY distance_range
ORDER BY pair_count, distance_range

-- Final calculation of fatality rates for helmet_used and helmet_not_used groups
WITH helmet_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
         CASE 
           WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM parties p 
             WHERE p.case_id = c.case_id 
               AND (p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%')
           ) THEN 'helmet used'
           WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM parties p 
             WHERE p.case_id = c.case_id 
               AND (p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%')
           ) THEN 'helmet not used'
           ELSE 'other'
         END as helmet_group
  FROM collisions c
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
)
SELECT 
  helmet_group,
  SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) as total_motorcyclist_fatalities,
  COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM helmet_cases
WHERE helmet_group IN ('helmet used', 'helmet not used')
GROUP BY helmet_group
ORDER BY helmet_group

WITH year_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(collision_date, 1, 4) as year,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_count,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 as share_pct
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY substr(collision_date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
  'speeding' as category,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2011' THEN share_pct END) as share_2011,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2021' THEN share_pct END) as share_2021,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2011' THEN share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2021' THEN share_pct END) as decrease
FROM year_stats

SELECT 
  'speeding' as pcf_violation_category,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2011' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
    ) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2011') * 100
    -
    1.0 * (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2021' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
    ) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2021') * 100
  , 2) as decrease_pct_points

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(collision_date, 1, 4) as year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_count,
    COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM collisions 
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY substr(collision_date, 1, 4)
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    100.0 * speeding_count / total_count as share
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  shares_2011.year as year_2011,
  shares_2021.year as year_2021,
  ROUND(shares_2011.share, 4) as share_2011,
  ROUND(shares_2021.share, 4) as share_2021,
  ROUND(shares_2011.share - shares_2021.share, 4) as decrease_in_percentage_points
FROM shares shares_2011
JOIN shares shares_2021 ON TRUE
WHERE shares_2011.year = '2011' AND shares_2021.year = '2021'

-- Final answer with all incidents as denominator
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
    COUNT(*) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2011, 2021)
  GROUP BY year
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    1.0 * speeding_count / total_count * 100 as share_pct
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT share_pct FROM shares WHERE year = 2011) - (SELECT share_pct FROM shares WHERE year = 2021) as percentage_point_decrease

WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT bw.bowler, p.player_name, bw.wickets, br.runs_conceded, 
       br.runs_conceded * 1.0 / bw.wickets as bowling_avg
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Final query: bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, 
    COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN e.extra_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
    ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b 
    ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY (1.0 * br.total_runs / bw.wickets) ASC

    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs_charged
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND er.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs', 'penalty')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)

    br.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets,
    br.runs_from_bat + COALESCE(be.extra_runs_charged, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    ROUND(1.0 * (br.runs_from_bat + COALESCE(be.extra_runs_charged, 0)) / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_extras be ON br.bowler = be.bowler
LEFT JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0

WHERE rn = 1

-- Final query: average of highest over totals across all matches
WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, 
           COALESCE(SUM(b.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored b
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = e.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id, innings_no) as rn
    FROM over_totals
),
winner_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs
    FROM max_over_per_match
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM winner_over

-- Final calculation of average highest over total runs across all matches
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT bbs.match_id, bbs.innings_no, bbs.over_id, bbs.bowler,
           COALESCE(SUM(bms.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbs
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bms ON bbs.match_id = bms.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bms.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bms.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bms.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbs.match_id = er.match_id AND bbs.over_id = er.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbs.match_id, bbs.innings_no, bbs.over_id, bbs.bowler
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no ASC, over_id ASC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

-- Final query: average of highest over totals across all matches
WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_over_runs,
           MIN(b.bowler) as bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_over_runs, bowler,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_over_runs DESC, innings_no ASC, over_id ASC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_over_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

-- Check: how many distinct matches have extra_runs data
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as match_count FROM extra_runs

-- Final query with integer cast
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) AS BIGINT) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
max_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) AS max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT om.match_id, om.over_id, om.innings_no, om.bowler, om.total_runs
    FROM over_runs om
    JOIN max_per_match mm ON om.match_id = mm.match_id
    WHERE om.total_runs = mm.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id) as rn
    FROM max_overs
)
SELECT bm.bowler AS player_id, p.player_name, bm.match_id, bm.total_runs AS runs_conceded

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip,
    LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng
  FROM olist_geolocation
),
with_dist AS (
  SELECT
    prev_state, prev_city, prev_zip, prev_lat, prev_lng,
    geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng,
    6371 * acos(
      GREATEST(-1, LEAST(1, 
        cos(prev_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * cos(geolocation_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * cos((geolocation_lng - prev_lng) * 3.141592653589793 / 180) + 
        sin(prev_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * sin(geolocation_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180)
      ))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ordered
  WHERE prev_state IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  prev_state AS state_1,
  prev_city AS city_1,
  prev_zip AS zip_1,
  prev_lat AS lat_1,
  prev_lng AS lng_1,
  geolocation_state AS state_2,
  geolocation_city AS city_2,
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_2,
  geolocation_lat AS lat_2,
  geolocation_lng AS lng_2
FROM with_dist 
ORDER BY distance_km DESC 
LIMIT 1

WITH sorted_data AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS rn
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.geolocation_state AS state1,
        s1.geolocation_city AS city1,
        s1.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip1,
        s1.geolocation_lat AS lat1,
        s1.geolocation_lng AS lng1,
        s2.geolocation_state AS state2,
        s2.geolocation_city AS city2,
        s2.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip2,
        s2.geolocation_lat AS lat2,
        s2.geolocation_lng AS lng2,
        6371 * ACOS(
            LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0,
                COS(RADIANS(s1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(s2.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(s2.geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(s1.geolocation_lng)) +
                SIN(RADIANS(s1.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(s2.geolocation_lat))
            ))
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM sorted_data s1
    JOIN sorted_data s2 ON s1.rn = s2.rn - 1
)
SELECT * FROM consecutive_pairs
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Final query: median of average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT p.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, 
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN promotions pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND pr.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY p.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_pivot AS (
    SELECT prod_id, calendar_month_number,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
       AND MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
),
projected AS (
    SELECT prod_id, calendar_month_number, sales_2019, sales_2020,
           CASE WHEN sales_2019 > 0 
                THEN sales_2020 + ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020
                ELSE sales_2020 
           END as projected_2021
    FROM sales_pivot
),
projected_with_currency AS (
    SELECT p.prod_id, p.calendar_month_number, p.projected_2021,
           c.to_us,
           p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON p.calendar_month_number = c.month 
                    AND 2021 = c.year
                    AND c.country = 'France'
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT calendar_month_number,
           ROUND(AVG(projected_usd), 2) as avg_monthly_usd
    FROM projected_with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT avg_monthly_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_monthly_usd) as rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () as total
    FROM monthly_averages
)
SELECT AVG(avg_monthly_usd) as median_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (CAST((total + 1) / 2 AS INTEGER), CAST((total + 2) / 2 AS INTEGER))

WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France' 
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2020,
        calendar_month_number
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT
        sp.calendar_month_number,
        (((sp.sales_2020 - sp.sales_2019) * 1.0 / sp.sales_2019) * sp.sales_2020) + sp.sales_2020 as projected_2021
    FROM sales_pivot sp
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(MEDIAN(projected_2021_usd), 2) as median_projected_sales_usd
FROM with_currency

WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q4_2019_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualified_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE q4_2019_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / q4_2019_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS product_city_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_city_sales) AS overall_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, overall_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_cnt
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20 AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM top_products
    WHERE rn <= CAST(total_cnt * 0.20 AS INTEGER)
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, SUM(product_city_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT cps.prod_id, cps.calendar_year, cps.product_city_sales, qt.total_sales,
       1.0 * cps.product_city_sales / qt.total_sales AS share
FROM city_product_sales cps
JOIN quarter_totals qt ON cps.calendar_year = qt.calendar_year
JOIN top_20 tp ON cps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
WHERE cps.prod_id IN (18, 15)

WITH us_customers AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_city
    FROM customers c
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
),
city_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        uc.cust_city,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY uc.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q2020.cust_city
    FROM city_quarter_sales q2020
    JOIN city_quarter_sales q2019 ON q2020.cust_city = q2019.cust_city
    WHERE q2019.total_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (q2020.total_sales - q2019.total_sales) / q2019.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_product_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) AS tile
    FROM city_product_totals
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE tile = 1
),
city_total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_quarter_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        cps.prod_id,
        cps.calendar_year,
        1.0 * cps.product_sales / cts.total_sales AS share
    FROM city_product_sales cps
    JOIN city_total_sales cts ON cps.calendar_year = cts.calendar_year
    JOIN top_products tp ON cps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) AS share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) AS share_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) - MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) AS share_change
FROM product_quarter_shares
GROUP BY prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC

-- Count products per tile
WITH city_sales AS (

        t.calendar_year,

    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id

),
qualifying_cities AS (

    WHERE q2019.calendar_year = 2019
        AND q2019.total_sales > 0

product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT

product_overall AS (

ranked AS (

ranked_products AS (

-- Step 4: For top 20% products, compute share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE sales_2019 > 0
        AND sales_2020 >= sales_2019 * 1.2
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name, total_sales
    FROM product_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (
        SELECT prod_id
        FROM product_sales
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) <= CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () * 0.2 AS INTEGER)
    )
),
-- Total sales per quarter in qualifying cities
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
-- Product sales per quarter in qualifying cities
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND s.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    tp.prod_id,
    tp.prod_name,
    pqs_2019.calendar_year as year_2019,
    pqs_2019.product_sales as sales_2019,
    qt_2019.total_quarter_sales as total_2019,
    1.0 * pqs_2019.product_sales / qt_2019.total_quarter_sales as share_2019,
    pqs_2020.calendar_year as year_2020,
    pqs_2020.product_sales as sales_2020,
    qt_2020.total_quarter_sales as total_2020,
    1.0 * pqs_2020.product_sales / qt_2020.total_quarter_sales as share_2020,
    1.0 * pqs_2020.product_sales / qt_2020.total_quarter_sales - 1.0 * pqs_2019.product_sales / qt_2019.total_quarter_sales as share_change
FROM top_products tp
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2019 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2019.prod_id AND pqs_2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2020 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2020.prod_id AND pqs_2020.calendar_year = 2020
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2019 ON qt_2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2020 ON qt_2020.calendar_year = 2020
ORDER BY share_change DESC

WITH q4_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cust_city,
    t.calendar_year,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT q4_2019.cust_city
  FROM q4_sales q4_2019
  JOIN q4_sales q4_2020 ON q4_2019.cust_city = q4_2020.cust_city
  WHERE q4_2019.calendar_year = 2019 AND q4_2020.calendar_year = 2020
    AND 1.0 * (q4_2020.total_sales - q4_2019.total_sales) / q4_2019.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.prod_id,
    t.calendar_year,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_id,
    SUM(product_sales) as overall_sales
  FROM city_product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_id,
    overall_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) as tile
  FROM product_overall
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM ranked_products WHERE tile = 1
),
total_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT 
    t.calendar_year,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT 
    cps.prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2019 THEN cps.product_sales END) as product_sales_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2020 THEN cps.product_sales END) as product_sales_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2019 THEN 1.0 * cps.product_sales / tby.total_sales END) as share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2020 THEN 1.0 * cps.product_sales / tby.total_sales END) as share_2020
  FROM city_product_sales cps
  JOIN total_by_quarter tby ON cps.calendar_year = tby.calendar_year
  WHERE cps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
  GROUP BY cps.prod_id
)
SELECT 
  ps.prod_id,
  p.prod_name,
  ps.share_2019,
  ps.share_2020,
  ps.share_2020 - ps.share_2019 as share_change
FROM product_share ps
JOIN products p ON ps.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC

-- Use proper 2021 month labels
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
       AND MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2020 + ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020 as projected_2021_local
    FROM pivoted
)
SELECT 
    '2021-' || LPAD(p.calendar_month_number::TEXT, 2, '0') as calendar_month,
    ROUND(AVG(p.projected_2021_local * c.to_us), 2) as avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projected p
JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
    AND c.year = 2021 
    AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
GROUP BY p.calendar_month_number, '2021-' || LPAD(p.calendar_month_number::TEXT, 2, '0')
ORDER BY p.calendar_month_number

WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND p.promo_total_id = 1
        AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, s.prod_id
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / sales_2019 * sales_2020) + sales_2020 as projected_2021
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2019 != 0
),
projected_with_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        wg.calendar_month_number,
        wg.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_usd
    FROM with_growth wg
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = wg.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    calendar_month_number,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_usd), 2) as avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projected_with_rate
GROUP BY calendar_month_number
ORDER BY calendar_month_number

WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND p.promo_total_id = 1
        AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        CASE 
            WHEN sales_2019 > 0 THEN ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / sales_2019)
            ELSE 0
        END as growth_rate
    FROM sales_pivoted
    WHERE sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2019 > 0
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2020 * (1.0 + growth_rate) as projected_2021
    FROM with_growth
)
SELECT 
    p.calendar_month_number,
    t.calendar_month_desc,
    ROUND(AVG(p.projected_2021 * c.to_us), 2) as avg_projected_usd
FROM projected p
JOIN times t ON p.calendar_month_number = t.calendar_month_number AND t.calendar_year = 2021
JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
GROUP BY p.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc
ORDER BY p.calendar_month_number

-- Find product-months that exist in both 2019 and 2020
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_month_desc,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc, s.prod_id
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        calendar_month_desc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number, calendar_month_desc
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pivoted
WHERE sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL

-- Final query with rounded profit values
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, 
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' 
      AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cust_id, total_profit,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) as bucket
    FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT bucket,
       COUNT(*) as num_customers,
       ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) as min_profit,
       ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit
  FROM profits p
  JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
range_info AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_val, MAX(total_profit) as max_val,
    (MAX(total_profit) - MIN(total_profit)) / 10.0 as bucket_width
  FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
    LEAST(CAST(FLOOR((cp.total_profit - ri.min_val) / ri.bucket_width) + 1 AS INTEGER), 10) as bucket
  FROM customer_profits cp, range_info ri
)
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) as num_customers, MIN(total_profit) as min_profit, MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

WITH us_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, s.cust_id, s.time_id, s.amount_sold,
         c.cust_city, c.country_id
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999 
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.time_id IN (
      SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    )
),
city_sales AS (
  SELECT cust_city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020
  FROM us_sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  GROUP BY cust_city
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END)
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT us.prod_id, us.amount_sold, us.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
  FROM us_sales us
  JOIN times t ON us.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE us.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS q_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
total_sales_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(q_sales) AS total_q_sales
  FROM product_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT pq.prod_id, pq.calendar_quarter_id,
    pq.q_sales,
    t.total_q_sales,
    1.0 * pq.q_sales / t.total_q_sales * 100 AS share_pct
  FROM product_quarter_sales pq
  JOIN total_sales_by_quarter t ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS nt
  FROM product_totals
),
top20_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM ranked_products WHERE nt = 1
),
share_changes AS (
  SELECT ps.prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END) AS share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) AS share_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END) AS pct_point_change,
    ABS(MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END)) AS abs_change
  FROM product_shares ps
  WHERE ps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top20_products)
  GROUP BY ps.prod_id
)
SELECT sc.prod_id, p.prod_name, sc.share_2019, sc.share_2020, sc.pct_point_change, sc.abs_change
FROM share_changes sc
JOIN products p ON sc.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY sc.abs_change ASC
LIMIT 30

WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND (SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END)) 
           / SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 0.20
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776) THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
total_sales_by_quarter AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS total_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS total_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
),
product_with_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.prod_id,
        ps.total_sales,
        ts.total_q4_2019,
        ts.total_q4_2020,
        1.0 * ps.sales_q4_2019 / ts.total_q4_2019 * 100 AS share_q4_2019,
        1.0 * ps.sales_q4_2020 / ts.total_q4_2020 * 100 AS share_q4_2020,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS tile
    FROM product_sales ps
    CROSS JOIN total_sales_by_quarter ts
),
top_20 AS (
    SELECT * FROM product_with_shares WHERE tile = 1
)
SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.share_q4_2019, t.share_q4_2020,
       t.share_q4_2020 - t.share_q4_2019 AS pct_point_change
FROM top_20 t
JOIN products p ON t.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY ABS(t.share_q4_2020 - t.share_q4_2019) ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Show all products with their percentage-point change, smallest absolute first
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cs1.cust_city
    FROM (
        SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
        FROM sales s
        JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
        JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
        JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
        WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
            AND s.promo_id = 999
            AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
    ) cs1
    JOIN (
        SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
        FROM sales s
        JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
        JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
        JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
        WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
            AND s.promo_id = 999
            AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
    ) cs2 ON cs1.cust_city = cs2.cust_city
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
        AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
        AND cs1.total_sales > 0
        AND 1.0 * cs2.total_sales / cs1.total_sales >= 1.20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales
    FROM product_ranked
    WHERE quintile = 1
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(product_sales) as product_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_percent)
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(product_sales) as quarter_total
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.product_sales,
        qt.quarter_total,
        ROUND(1.0 * pqs.product_sales / qt.quarter_total * 100, 4) as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_share_pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct END) as share_q4_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct END) as share_q4_2020
    FROM product_shares
    GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    share_q4_2019,
    share_q4_2020,

FROM product_share_pivot

),
product_quarter_sales AS (

        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id

        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)

product_totals AS (
