-- Final query with ROUND for clean output
WITH all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_year
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        m.month_year,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
                 SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id 
        AND m.month_year = substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7)
        AND substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
        AND ct.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.month_year
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balance
    GROUP BY month_year
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference
FROM ranked_months
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) 
        - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date <= '2020-12-31'
    GROUP BY substr(txn_date, 1, 7), customer_id
),
month_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM month_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference

-- Detailed verification
WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
months AS (
    SELECT unnest(['2020-01', '2020-02', '2020-03', '2020-04']) as month
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT * FROM all_customers CROSS JOIN months
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
all_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month,
        COALESCE(mb.month_end_balance, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_balances mb ON cm.customer_id = mb.customer_id AND cm.month = mb.month
),
positive_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) as positive_count
    FROM all_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month
),
month_with_highest AS (
    SELECT month FROM positive_counts ORDER BY positive_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
month_with_lowest AS (
    SELECT month FROM positive_counts ORDER BY positive_count ASC LIMIT 1
),
avg_highest AS (
    SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_bal FROM all_balances 
    WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM month_with_highest)
),
avg_lowest AS (
    SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_bal FROM all_balances 
    WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM month_with_lowest)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT month FROM month_with_highest) as highest_month,
    (SELECT month FROM month_with_lowest) as lowest_month,
    avg_highest.avg_bal as avg_highest,
    avg_lowest.avg_bal as avg_lowest,
    avg_highest.avg_bal - avg_lowest.avg_bal as difference
FROM avg_highest, avg_lowest

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE))::INTEGER AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE))::INTEGER AS month_num,
    CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE))
      WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    END AS month_name,
    COUNT(*) AS city_count
  FROM cities
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (4, 5, 6)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (2021, 2022, 2023)
  GROUP BY year, month_num, month_name
),
with_running_total AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month_num,
    month_name,
    city_count,
    CAST(SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS INTEGER) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_counts
),
with_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month_num,
    month_name,
    city_count,
    running_total,
    ROUND(100.0 * (city_count - LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year)) / LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year), 2) AS monthly_growth_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * (running_total - LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year)) / LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year), 2) AS running_total_growth_pct
  FROM with_running_total
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month_name,
  city_count,
  running_total,
  monthly_growth_pct,
  running_total_growth_pct
FROM with_growth
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, month_num

    SELECT DATE '2021-07-01' + (n || ' day')::INTERVAL AS date_val
    FROM generate_series(0, 30) AS g(n)

joined AS (

),
with_rownums AS (
    SELECT

        has_entry,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY date_val) as rn
    FROM joined
),
grouped AS (

        date_val,
        has_entry,
        date_val - (rn || ' day')::INTERVAL AS grp
    FROM with_rownums
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
pizza_info AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.exclusions,
        b.extras,
        b.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name,
        pr.toppings as recipe_toppings
    FROM base b
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON b.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON b.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pi.order_id,
        pi.customer_id,
        pi.exclusions,
        pi.extras,
        pi.order_time,
        pi.pizza_name,
        trim(t.value) as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_info pi,
         UNNEST(string_split(pi.recipe_toppings, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.value)::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
),
excluded_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pi.row_id,
        trim(t.value)::INTEGER as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_info pi,
         UNNEST(string_split(pi.exclusions, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.value)::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pi.exclusions IS NOT NULL
),
extra_names AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pi.order_id,
        pi.customer_id,
        pi.order_time,
        pi.pizza_name,
        trim(t.value)::INTEGER as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_info pi,
         UNNEST(string_split(pi.extras, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.value)::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pi.extras IS NOT NULL
),
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT st.row_id, st.order_id, st.customer_id, st.order_time, st.pizza_name, st.topping_name, 1 as cnt
    FROM standard_toppings st
    LEFT JOIN excluded_names ex ON st.row_id = ex.row_id AND st.topping_name = ex.topping_name

WITH 
pizza_toppings_list AS (
    SELECT pizza_id, 
           trim(unnest(string_split(toppings, ','))) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_recipes
),
pizza_standard AS (
    SELECT p.pizza_id,
           list(t.topping_name) AS standard_names,
           list(t.topping_id) AS standard_ids
    FROM pizza_toppings_list p
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(p.topping_id AS INTEGER)
    GROUP BY p.pizza_id
),
numbered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, order_time) AS row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        n.row_id,
        n.order_id,
        n.customer_id,
        n.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        n.order_time,
        ps.standard_names,
        n.exclusions AS excl_str,
        n.extras AS extras_str
    FROM numbered_orders n
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_standard ps ON ps.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
),
excl_expanded AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           trim(unnest(string_split(excl_str, ','))) AS excl_topping_id
    FROM combined
    WHERE excl_str IS NOT NULL AND excl_str != ''
),
extras_expanded AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           trim(unnest(string_split(extras_str, ','))) AS extra_topping_id
    FROM combined
    WHERE extras_str IS NOT NULL AND extras_str != ''
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT c.row_id,
           t.topping_name,
           1 AS count_val
    FROM combined c
    JOIN pizza_toppings_list ptl ON ptl.pizza_id = c.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(ptl.topping_id AS INTEGER)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM excl_expanded ee 
        WHERE ee.row_id = c.row_id 
        AND ee.excl_topping_id = ptl.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.row_id,
           t.topping_name,
           1 AS count_val
    FROM combined c
    JOIN extras_expanded ee ON ee.row_id = c.row_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(ee.extra_topping_id AS INTEGER)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           topping_name,
           SUM(count_val) AS total_count
    FROM ingredient_counts
    GROUP BY row_id, topping_name
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           topping_name,
           total_count,
           CASE WHEN total_count > 1 THEN '2x ' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END AS formatted_name
    FROM counts
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        c.row_id,
        c.order_id,
        c.customer_id,
        c.pizza_name,
        c.order_time,
        string_agg(f.formatted_name, ', ' ORDER BY 
            CASE WHEN f.total_count > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            f.topping_name
        ) AS ingredients
    FROM combined c
    LEFT JOIN formatted f ON f.row_id = c.row_id
    GROUP BY c.row_id, c.order_id, c.customer_id, c.pizza_name, c.order_time
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients AS ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id

standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        rco.rowid AS row_id,
        rco.order_id,
        rco.customer_id,

        pn.pizza_name,

    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = rco.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pr.pizza_id = rco.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pr.toppings, ', ')) AS st(top_id)

),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        st.row_id,
        st.order_id,
        st.customer_id,
        st.pizza_name,
        st.order_time,
        st.topping_name
    FROM standard_toppings st
    LEFT JOIN excluded_topping_ids et ON et.row_id = st.row_id AND et.exc_id = st.topping_id
    WHERE et.exc_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        et.row_id,
        et.order_id,
        rco.customer_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        rco.order_time,
        t.topping_name
    FROM extra_topping_ids et
    JOIN pizza_clean_customer_orders rco ON rco.rowid = et.row_id
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = rco.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = et.extra_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        topping_name,

ranked AS (

            PARTITION BY row_id 
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, topping_name
        ) AS rn
    FROM formatted
),
aggregated AS (

WITH order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
pizza_with_recipe AS (
    SELECT 
        op.row_id,
        op.order_id,
        op.customer_id,
        op.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        op.exclusions,
        op.extras,
        op.order_time,
        pr.toppings as recipe_toppings
    FROM order_pizzas op
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON op.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON op.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
recipe_tops AS (
    SELECT 
        pwr.row_id,
        pwr.order_id,
        pwr.customer_id,
        pwr.pizza_id,
        pwr.pizza_name,
        pwr.order_time,
        pt.topping_name as ingredient
    FROM pizza_with_recipe pwr
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pwr.recipe_toppings, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRIM(t.value)::INT = pt.topping_id
),
excluded_tops AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pwr.row_id,
        pt.topping_name as ingredient
    FROM pizza_with_recipe pwr
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pwr.exclusions, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRIM(t.value)::INT = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pwr.exclusions IS NOT NULL
),
extra_tops AS (
    SELECT 
        pwr.row_id,
        pwr.order_id,
        pwr.customer_id,
        pwr.pizza_id,
        pwr.pizza_name,
        pwr.order_time,
        pt.topping_name as ingredient
    FROM pizza_with_recipe pwr
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pwr.extras, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRIM(t.value)::INT = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pwr.extras IS NOT NULL
),
all_ingredients AS (
    SELECT rt.row_id, rt.order_id, rt.customer_id, rt.pizza_id, rt.pizza_name, rt.order_time, rt.ingredient
    FROM recipe_tops rt
    LEFT JOIN excluded_tops et ON rt.row_id = et.row_id AND rt.ingredient = et.ingredient
    WHERE et.ingredient IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT et2.row_id, et2.order_id, et2.customer_id, et2.pizza_id, et2.pizza_name, et2.order_time, et2.ingredient
    FROM extra_tops et2
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        ingredient,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, ingredient
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        ingredient,
        cnt,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x ' || ingredient ELSE ingredient END as formatted_ingredient,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_key
    FROM ingredient_counts
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_name,
        order_time,
        string_agg(formatted_ingredient, ', ' ORDER BY sort_key, formatted_ingredient) as ingredients_str
    FROM formatted
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients_str as final_ingredients
FROM agg
ORDER BY row_id

    FROM pizza_recipes r,
         unnest(split(trim(r.toppings), ',')) as t(topping_id)

),
excluded_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        trim(ex.topping_id::VARCHAR) as topping_id
    FROM order_items oi,
         unnest(split(trim(oi.exclusions), ',')) as ex(topping_id)
    WHERE oi.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND oi.exclusions != ''
),
extra_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        trim(ex.topping_id::VARCHAR) as topping_id
    FROM order_items oi,
         unnest(split(trim(oi.extras), ',')) as ex(topping_id)
    WHERE oi.extras IS NOT NULL AND oi.extras != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        eti.row_id,
        eti.topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM extra_topping_ids eti
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON eti.topping_id = CAST(pt.topping_id AS VARCHAR)
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.customer_id,
        oi.pizza_id,
        oi.order_time,
        rt.topping_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN recipe_toppings rt ON oi.pizza_id = rt.pizza_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM excluded_topping_ids et WHERE et.row_id = oi.row_id AND et.topping_id = rt.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        oi.row_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.customer_id,
        oi.pizza_id,
        oi.order_time,
        et.topping_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN extra_toppings et ON oi.row_id = et.row_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
        topping_name,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name
),
multi_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
           string_agg('2x' || topping_name, ', ' ORDER BY topping_name) as multi_ingredients
    FROM (
        SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name, cnt
        FROM topping_counts
        WHERE cnt > 1
    )
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
),
single_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
           string_agg(topping_name, ', ' ORDER BY topping_name) as single_ingredients
    FROM (
        SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name, cnt
        FROM topping_counts
        WHERE cnt = 1
    )
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
)
SELECT 
    tc.row_id,
    tc.order_id,
    tc.customer_id,
    tn.pizza_name,
    tc.order_time,
    COALESCE(multi.multi_ingredients, '') as multi_ing,
    COALESCE(single.single_ingredients, '') as single_ing
FROM topping_counts tc
JOIN pizza_names tn ON tc.pizza_id = tn.pizza_id
LEFT JOIN multi_ingredients multi ON tc.row_id = multi.row_id
LEFT JOIN single_ingredients single ON tc.row_id = single.row_id
GROUP BY tc.row_id, tc.order_id, tc.customer_id, tn.pizza_name, tc.order_time, multi.multi_ingredients, single.single_ingredients
ORDER BY tc.row_id

WITH months AS (
  SELECT unnest(generate_series(0, 3)) as n
),
months_expanded AS (
  SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' + (n * INTERVAL '1' MONTH) as month_start
  FROM months
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_start
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months_expanded m
),
monthly_net AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date::DATE) as month_str,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date::DATE)
)
SELECT 
  acm.customer_id,
  strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(acm.month_start AS DATE)) as month,
  COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0) as monthly_change,
  SUM(COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY acm.customer_id 
    ORDER BY acm.month_start
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) as cumulative_balance
FROM all_customer_months acm
LEFT JOIN monthly_net mn 
  ON acm.customer_id = mn.customer_id 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(acm.month_start AS DATE)) = mn.month_str
ORDER BY acm.customer_id, acm.month_start

-- Final query with all columns: customer_id, month, monthly_change, closing_balance (cumulative)
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month
  FROM customer_transactions
  ORDER BY month
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.month,

                WHEN t.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -t.txn_amount

    FROM all_customers c

WITH purchased_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id 
    FROM shopping_cart_events 
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.product_id,
        p.page_name,
        e.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
-- Views per product
views AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as page_views
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 1
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
),
-- Add to cart per product
add_to_cart AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
),
-- Abandoned (added to cart but visit had no purchase)
abandoned AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.product_id,
        pe.page_name,
        COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    AND pe.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchased_visits)
    GROUP BY pe.product_id, pe.page_name
),
-- Purchases per product (product was added to cart in a visit that resulted in purchase)
purchases AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.product_id,
        pe.page_name,
        COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    AND pe.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchased_visits)
    GROUP BY pe.product_id, pe.page_name
)
SELECT 
    v.product_id,
    v.page_name,
    v.page_views AS product_views,
    a.add_to_cart_count AS add_to_cart,
    ab.left_in_cart_count AS left_in_cart,
    p.purchase_count AS purchases
FROM views v
JOIN add_to_cart a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN abandoned ab ON v.product_id = ab.product_id
JOIN purchases p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY v.product_id

WITH viewed AS (

    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 1
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
added AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as added_to_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.visit_id NOT IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
purchased AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.visit_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
)
SELECT 
    v.product_id,
    v.view_count AS views,
    a.added_to_cart_count AS added_to_cart,
    l.left_in_cart_count AS left_in_cart,
    p.purchase_count AS purchases
FROM viewed v
JOIN added a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN left_in_cart l ON v.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN purchased p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY v.product_id

WITH visit_purchases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.visit_id, ph.product_id, ph.product_category
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
      AND e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
),
visit_no_purchase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.visit_id, ph.product_id, ph.product_category
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
      AND e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id NOT IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
),
page_views AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, ph.product_category, COUNT(*) as viewed_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
      AND e.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.product_category
),
add_to_cart_total AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, ph.product_category, COUNT(*) as added_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
      AND e.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.product_category
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_category, COUNT(*) as purchased_count
    FROM visit_purchases
    GROUP BY product_id, product_category
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_category, COUNT(*) as left_count
    FROM visit_no_purchase
    GROUP BY product_id, product_category
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(pv.product_id, atc.product_id, pu.product_id, lic.product_id) as product_id,
    COALESCE(pv.product_category, atc.product_category, pu.product_category, lic.product_category) as product_category,
    COALESCE(pv.viewed_count, 0) as times_viewed,
    COALESCE(atc.added_count, 0) as times_added_to_cart,
    COALESCE(lic.left_count, 0) as times_left_in_cart,
    COALESCE(pu.purchased_count, 0) as times_purchased
FROM page_views pv
FULL OUTER JOIN add_to_cart_total atc ON pv.product_id = atc.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN purchases pu ON COALESCE(pv.product_id, atc.product_id) = pu.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN left_in_cart lic ON COALESCE(pv.product_id, atc.product_id, pu.product_id) = lic.product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH monthly_avg AS (
  SELECT month_year, interest_id, AVG(1.0 * composition / index_value) AS avg_comp_ratio
  FROM interest_metrics

  GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),

  FROM monthly_avg

monthly_top AS (
  SELECT t.month_year, im.interest_name, t.avg_comp_ratio AS max_index_comp

  JOIN interest_map im ON t.interest_id = im.id
  WHERE t.rn = 1

  FROM monthly_top

       LAG(o.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY o.rn) AS prev_interest_name,
       LAG(o.max_index_comp, 1) OVER (ORDER BY o.rn) AS prev_max_index_comp,
       LAG(o.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY o.rn) AS prev2_interest_name,

FROM ordered o

    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN Movie m ON c.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_year_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        movie_year,
        LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) as prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),

    SELECT DISTINCT PID
    FROM actor_year_ranked
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL AND (movie_year - prev_year) > 4
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID) as count_actors
FROM actor_years
WHERE PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_violation)

    SELECT mc.pid, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) AS movie_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mc.pid, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT pid, movie_year,
           LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY movie_year) AS prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
max_gaps AS (
    SELECT pid, MAX(CASE WHEN prev_year IS NOT NULL THEN movie_year - prev_year ELSE 0 END) AS max_gap
    FROM with_lag
    GROUP BY pid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count
FROM max_gaps
WHERE max_gap <= 4

           TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.year, '[^0-9]', '') AS INTEGER) as film_year

    FROM actor_years

    SELECT DISTINCT PID
    FROM sorted_years

),

)

FROM all_actors a
WHERE a.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actor_has_gap)

WITH region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wa.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = wa.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amt_usd) DESC) AS rk
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wa.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = wa.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.num_orders,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    rt.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(rt.rep_total_sales, 2) AS rep_total_sales
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN rep_totals rt ON rt.region_name = rs.region_name AND rt.rk = 1
ORDER BY rs.region_name

        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS first_strength,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS second_strength
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            EntertainerID,
            StyleID,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) AS rank
        FROM Entertainer_Styles
    )
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
)

    e.EntStageName,
    c.CustLastName
FROM cust_prefs cp

JOIN Entertainers e ON e.EntertainerID = es.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
WHERE (cp.first_pref = es.first_strength AND cp.second_pref = es.second_strength)
   OR (cp.first_pref = es.second_strength AND cp.second_pref = es.first_strength)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName

WITH annual_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.businessentityid,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', TRY_CAST(soh.orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(soh.totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as total_sales
    FROM salesorderheader soh
    JOIN salesperson sp ON soh.salespersonid = sp.businessentityid
    WHERE soh.salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND soh.salespersonid != ''
    GROUP BY sp.businessentityid, CAST(strftime('%Y', TRY_CAST(soh.orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT 
        BusinessEntityID,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) as total_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, CAST(strftime('%Y', TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
    a.businessentityid,
    a.year,
    ROUND(a.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(q.total_quota, 2) as total_quota,
    ROUND(a.total_sales - q.total_quota, 2) as difference
FROM annual_sales a
JOIN annual_quota q ON a.businessentityid = q.BusinessEntityID AND a.year = q.year
ORDER BY a.businessentityid, a.year

-- Build the full query: salesperson annual sales vs quota
WITH sales_totals AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) as businessentityid, 
           strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) as order_year, 
           SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as total_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid != ''
    GROUP BY businessentityid, strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE))
),
quota_latest AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) as BusinessEntityID, 
           strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) as quota_year, 
           TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE) as latest_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER), strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) ORDER BY QuotaDate DESC) = 1
)
SELECT st.businessentityid as salespersonid, 
       st.order_year,
       ROUND(st.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
       ROUND(q.latest_quota, 2) as annual_quota,
       ROUND(st.total_sales - q.latest_quota, 2) as difference
FROM sales_totals st
LEFT JOIN quota_latest q ON st.businessentityid = q.BusinessEntityID AND st.order_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY st.businessentityid, st.order_year

-- Final query with proper types
WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT 
    dm.name_id,
    m.id as movie_id,
    m.date_published,
    m.duration,
    r.avg_rating,
    r.total_votes,
    LAG(m.date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.date_published) as prev_date
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
  JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
director_intermovie AS (
  SELECT 
    name_id,
    movie_id,
    date_published,
    duration,
    avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    prev_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN 
        CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_published - prev_date)) / 86400 AS INTEGER)
      ELSE NULL 
    END as days_between
  FROM director_movies
),
director_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    name_id,
    COUNT(*) as movie_count,
    ROUND(AVG(days_between)) as avg_intermovie_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
    CAST(SUM(total_votes) AS BIGINT) as total_votes,
    MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
    MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
    SUM(duration) as total_duration
  FROM director_intermovie
  GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
  ds.name_id as director_id,
  n.name as director_name,
  ds.movie_count,
  ds.avg_intermovie_duration,
  ds.avg_rating,
  ds.total_votes,
  ds.min_rating,
  ds.max_rating,
  ds.total_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN names n ON ds.name_id = n.id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

    WHERE bt.ticker = bp.ticker
      AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
),

    SELECT 
        region,

-- Build full query with LAG for previous day volume and pct change
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
            ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
        END AS volume_num
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE market_date IN ('01-08-2021','02-08-2021','03-08-2021','04-08-2021','05-08-2021','06-08-2021','07-08-2021','08-08-2021','09-08-2021','10-08-2021')
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        volume_num,
        LAG(volume_num) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) AS prev_volume
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    volume_num,
    prev_volume,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_volume IS NULL OR prev_volume = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (volume_num - prev_volume) / prev_volume * 100
    END AS pct_change
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY ticker, market_date

      WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
      ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)

  FROM converted
)

),

        c.id_bioguide,
        c.initial_term_start,
        yn.year_num,

year_offsets AS (

-- For each cohort member and year offset, compute the check date
check_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    c.id_bioguide,
    c.first_term_start,
    y.year_offset,
    (c.first_term_start + CAST(y.year_offset AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE as check_date
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN year_offsets y
),
-- For each check, find if any term covers that date
retained AS (
  SELECT 
    cd.id_bioguide,
    cd.year_offset,
    cd.check_date,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= cd.check_date AND lt.term_end::DATE >= cd.check_date THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM check_dates cd
  LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY cd.id_bioguide, cd.year_offset, cd.check_date
)
SELECT 
  year_offset,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(retained) as retained_count,
  1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
FROM retained
GROUP BY year_offset

    ly.year_num,

      SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt

        AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ly.check_date

WITH customer_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_date,
    amount,
    MIN(payment_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) as first_payment,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (payment_date - MIN(payment_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id))) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
  FROM payment
),
customer_ltv AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    SUM(amount) as total_ltv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first <= 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first <= 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days
  FROM customer_payments
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(100.0 * ltv_7days / total_ltv), 2) as avg_pct_7days,
  ROUND(AVG(100.0 * ltv_30days / total_ltv), 2) as avg_pct_30days,
  ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_ltv
WHERE total_ltv > 0

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
film_actor_count AS (
    SELECT 
        film_id,
        COUNT(actor_id) as num_actors
    FROM film_actor

),

    SELECT 
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fa.actor_id,
        fr.total_revenue / 1.0 / fac.num_actors as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_revenue fr
    JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fr.film_id = fac.film_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        title,
        revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn

    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id

    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)

       AVG(ca.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
       AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental fr

WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT t.customer_id, t.first_name, t.last_name,
           date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
           SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
    GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.first_name, t.last_name, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, payment_month, monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_payments
)
SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, payment_month,
       ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) as month_over_month_diff,
       ROUND(ABS(monthly_total - prev_month_total), 2) as abs_diff
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(monthly_total - prev_month_total) DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Final query: Get the customer name and format the result
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    WHERE customer_id IN (526, 148, 144, 178, 137, 459, 469, 468, 236, 181)

),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_month, monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name,
       c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as customer_name,
       payment_month,
       monthly_total,
       prev_month_total,
       ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) as month_over_month_diff
FROM with_lag wl
JOIN customer c ON wl.customer_id = c.customer_id

        s.store_id,

        CAST(strftime('%m', r.rental_date) AS INTEGER) AS rental_month,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, strftime('%Y', r.rental_date), strftime('%m', r.rental_date)) AS rn
    FROM rental r
    JOIN staff s ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id

  SELECT DISTINCT words
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
),

  SELECT words,
         string_agg(letter, '' ORDER BY letter) AS anagram_key
  FROM filtered,
       unnest(split(words, '')) AS letter
  GROUP BY words
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT words, anagram_key,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY anagram_key) AS anagram_count
  FROM with_key

  FROM word_chars

  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

         AVG(a.age) as avg_age,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count
  FROM alien_data a
  INNER JOIN state_pop sp ON a.state = sp.state
  GROUP BY a.state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as result

WITH store_totals AS (
    SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) as total_orders
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY store_id
),
top_store AS (
    SELECT store_id, total_orders
    FROM store_totals
    ORDER BY total_orders DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
delivered_counts AS (
    SELECT o.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN o.order_id END) as delivered_count
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id
    GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT 
    ts.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    ts.total_orders,
    1.0 * dc.delivered_count / ts.total_orders as delivered_ratio
FROM top_store ts
JOIN stores s ON ts.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN delivered_counts dc ON ts.store_id = dc.store_id

SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN o.order_id END) as delivered_orders,
    1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as delivered_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY total_orders DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT

    h.hub_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feb_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mar_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    END AS pct_increase
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN hubs h ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
  AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)

        ELSE 1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

    END as pct_increase

-- Calculate average daily deliveries per driver
-- Average = total deliveries / number of distinct days with deliveries
SELECT d.driver_id,
       COUNT(*) as total_deliveries,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_created_year * 10000 + o.order_created_month * 100 + o.order_created_day) as days_with_deliveries,
       1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_created_year * 10000 + o.order_created_month * 100 + o.order_created_day) as avg_daily_deliveries
FROM deliveries d
JOIN orders o ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
WHERE d.driver_id IS NOT NULL

-- Calculate the median of highest season goals per team
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_api_id,
        m.season,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal 
                 WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal 
                 ELSE 0 END) as total_goals
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
    GROUP BY t.team_api_id, m.season
),
team_max_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        MAX(total_goals) as highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT median(highest_season_goals) as median_highest_season_goals
FROM team_max_goals

-- Count teams and compute median
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, season, SUM(total_goals) AS season_total
    FROM (
        SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, season, home_team_goal AS total_goals
        FROM Match
        UNION ALL
        SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_api_id, season, away_team_goal AS total_goals
        FROM Match
    )
    GROUP BY team_api_id, season
),
team_highest_season AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, MAX(season_total) AS highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_teams,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY highest_season_goals) AS median_highest_season_goals
FROM team_highest_season;

-- Final query with proper integer types
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CAST(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INTEGER) AS home_wins,
        CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS away_wins
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS home_wins,
        CAST(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INTEGER) AS away_wins
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(home_wins + away_wins) AS total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_api_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT 
    l.name AS league_name,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    r.total_wins
FROM ranked r
JOIN League l ON r.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY l.name

WITH batsmen AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, b.striker ASC) as rank
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.striker
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, b.striker ASC) <= 3
),
bowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season_id,
        b.bowler as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_wickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bowler ASC) as rank
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.bowler
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bowler ASC) <= 3
)
SELECT 
    b.season_id,
    b.player_id as batsman_id,
    p1.player_name as batsman_name,
    CAST(b.total_runs AS INTEGER) as batsman_runs,
    bow.player_id as bowler_id,
    p2.player_name as bowler_name,
    bow.total_wickets as bowler_wickets,
    b.rank as position
FROM batsmen b
JOIN bowlers bow ON b.season_id = bow.season_id AND b.rank = bow.rank
JOIN player p1 ON b.player_id = p1.player_id
JOIN player p2 ON bow.player_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY b.season_id, b.rank

-- Check if any ball has striker = non_striker

-- Final query with clean column names
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no,
        b.striker, b.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as batsman_runs,
        COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as extra_runs,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT *,
        LAG(striker) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as prev_striker,
        LAG(non_striker) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as prev_non_striker
    FROM ball_data
),
with_partner_flag AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_striker IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN (LEAST(striker, non_striker) = LEAST(prev_striker, prev_non_striker) AND GREATEST(striker, non_striker) = GREATEST(prev_striker, prev_non_striker)) THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END as new_partnership
    FROM with_prev
),
partnership_ids AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as partnership_id
    FROM with_partner_flag
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, partnership_id,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) as bat1,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as bat2,
        SUM(total_runs) as partnership_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = LEAST(striker, non_striker) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) as bat1_batsman_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = GREATEST(striker, non_striker) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) as bat2_batsman_runs
    FROM partnership_ids
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, partnership_id, LEAST(striker, non_striker), GREATEST(striker, non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.bat1, p.bat2, p.partnership_runs, p.bat1_batsman_runs, p.bat2_batsman_runs
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1 ELSE bat2 END
        END as player1,
        CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2 ELSE bat1 END
        END as player2,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1_batsman_runs
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2_batsman_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1_batsman_runs ELSE bat2_batsman_runs END
        END AS INTEGER) as player1_score,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2_batsman_runs
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1_batsman_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2_batsman_runs ELSE bat1_batsman_runs END
        END AS INTEGER) as player2_score,
        CAST(partnership_runs AS INTEGER) as partnership_runs
    FROM top_partnerships
)
SELECT * FROM ordered
ORDER BY match_id

-- Good, this looks reasonable. Now I need to also include individual scores.
-- The individual score for each player = sum of runs_scored where they were striker
-- across all innings in that match.

-- Let me build the full query with individual scores
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.non_striker, COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           LEAST(striker, non_striker) as player1,
           GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as player2,
           SUM(runs_scored) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, LEAST(striker, non_striker), GREATEST(striker, non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, player1, player2, partnership_runs,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) as rnk
    FROM partnerships
),
striker_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker as player_id, SUM(runs_scored) as individual_score
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
)
SELECT mp.match_id, mp.player1, mp.player2, mp.partnership_runs,
       COALESCE(s1.individual_score, 0) as player1_score,
       COALESCE(s2.individual_score, 0) as player2_score
FROM max_partnerships mp
LEFT JOIN striker_runs s1 ON mp.match_id = s1.match_id AND mp.player1 = s1.player_id
LEFT JOIN striker_runs s2 ON mp.match_id = s2.match_id AND mp.player2 = s2.player_id
WHERE mp.rnk = 1
ORDER BY mp.match_id
LIMIT 20

WITH ball_runs AS (SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.striker, CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END AS p1, CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END AS p2, bs.runs_scored AS rs FROM ball_by_ball b JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no), partnership AS (SELECT match_id, innings_no, p1, p2, SUM(rs) AS partnership_runs FROM ball_runs GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, p1, p2), max_partnership AS (SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) AS max_runs FROM partnership GROUP BY match_id), best_pairs AS (SELECT p.match_id, p.p1, p.p2, p.partnership_runs FROM partnership p JOIN max_partnership m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs), player_scores AS (SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id, SUM(rs) AS individual_score FROM ball_runs GROUP BY match_id, striker) SELECT bp.match_id, bp.p1, bp.p2, bp.partnership_runs, COALESCE(ps1.individual_score, 0) AS score1, COALESCE(ps2.individual_score, 0) AS score2 FROM best_pairs bp LEFT JOIN player_scores ps1 ON bp.match_id = ps1.match_id AND bp.p1 = ps1.player_id LEFT JOIN player_scores ps2 ON bp.match_id = ps2.match_id AND bp.p2 = ps2.player_id WHERE bp.match_id = 729312

-- Let me think about this differently. The question asks for "partnership runs" for each match.
-- A partnership is between two batsmen who are at the crease together.
-- For each ball, the two batsmen at the crease are striker and non_striker.
-- The runs scored on that ball contribute to their partnership.
-- 
-- But wait - I need to think about this more carefully. The "runs_scored" in batsman_scored
-- is attributed to the striker. But for byes/legbyes, the runs might be credited differently.
-- 
-- Actually, for partnership purposes, I think we should consider:
-- - Each ball: the total runs (runs_scored + extra_runs if any) are added to the partnership
--   of the two batsmen at the crease (striker + non_striker)
--
-- Let me also include extra runs in the partnership calculation.

WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, striker, non_striker,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as rn
    FROM ball_by_ball
),
with_pair AS (
    SELECT *,
           LEAST(striker, non_striker) as bat1,
           GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as bat2
    FROM ball_data
),
with_pair_change AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN (bat1 = LAG(bat1) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn) 
                   AND bat2 = LAG(bat2) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn))
                THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as pair_changed
    FROM with_pair
),
with_segment AS (
    SELECT *,
           SUM(pair_changed) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn) as segment_id
    FROM with_pair_change
),
segment_runs AS (
    SELECT ws.match_id, ws.innings_no, ws.segment_id,
           ws.bat1 as player1, ws.bat2 as player2,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ws.striker = ws.bat1 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) ELSE 0 END) as player1_score,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ws.striker = ws.bat2 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) ELSE 0 END) as player2_score,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM with_segment ws
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON ws.match_id = bs.match_id AND ws.over_id = bs.over_id AND ws.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND ws.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY ws.match_id, ws.innings_no, ws.segment_id, ws.bat1, ws.bat2
),
max_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM segment_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT sr.match_id, sr.player1, sr.player2, sr.player1_score, sr.player2_score, sr.partnership_runs
    FROM segment_runs sr
    JOIN max_partnership mp ON sr.match_id = mp.match_id AND sr.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
)
SELECT match_id, player1, player2, player1_score, player2_score, partnership_runs
FROM qualified
WHERE match_id = 392207
ORDER BY match_id, partnership_runs DESC

WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.innings_no,
        bbb.striker,
        bbb.non_striker,
        CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS BIGINT) AS striker_runs,
        CAST(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS BIGINT) AS extra_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
player_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        striker AS player_id,
        SUM(striker_runs) AS individual_score
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
),
pair_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) AS p1_raw,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) AS p2_raw,
        SUM(striker_runs + extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker, non_striker
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        p1_raw,
        p2_raw,
        SUM(partnership_runs) AS total_partnership_runs
    FROM pair_partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id, p1_raw, p2_raw
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_partnership_runs) AS max_partnership
    FROM pair_totals
    GROUP BY match_id
),
best_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.match_id,
        pt.p1_raw,
        pt.p2_raw,
        pt.total_partnership_runs AS partnership_score,
        COALESCE(ps1.individual_score, 0) AS p1_score,
        COALESCE(ps2.individual_score, 0) AS p2_score
    FROM pair_totals pt
    JOIN max_partnerships mp ON pt.match_id = mp.match_id AND pt.total_partnership_runs = mp.max_partnership
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps1 ON pt.match_id = ps1.match_id AND pt.p1_raw = ps1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps2 ON pt.match_id = ps2.match_id AND pt.p2_raw = ps2.player_id
),
final_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p1_raw ELSE p2_raw END AS player1,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p2_raw ELSE p1_raw END AS player2,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p1_score ELSE p2_score END AS score1,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p2_score ELSE p1_score END AS score2,
        partnership_score
    FROM best_pairs
)
SELECT 
    CAST(match_id AS BIGINT) AS match_id,
    CAST(player1 AS BIGINT) AS player1,
    CAST(score1 AS BIGINT) AS score1,
    CAST(player2 AS BIGINT) AS player2,
    CAST(score2 AS BIGINT) AS score2,
    CAST(partnership_score AS BIGINT) AS partnership_score
FROM final_pairs
ORDER BY match_id, player1, player2

WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.striker, bb.non_striker,
           COALESCE(b.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) as total_ball_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored b ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON e.match_id = bb.match_id AND e.over_id = bb.over_id AND e.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND e.innings_no = bb.innings_no
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           LEAST(striker, non_striker) as player_a,
           GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as player_b,
           SUM(total_ball_runs) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, LEAST(striker, non_striker), GREATEST(striker, non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.player_a, p.player_b, p.partnership_runs
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker as player_id, SUM(total_ball_runs) as individual_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
),
with_scores AS (
    SELECT tp.match_id, tp.player_a, tp.player_b, tp.partnership_runs,
           COALESCE(i1.individual_runs, 0) as score_a,
           COALESCE(i2.individual_runs, 0) as score_b
    FROM top_partnerships tp
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores i1 ON tp.match_id = i1.match_id AND tp.player_a = i1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores i2 ON tp.match_id = i2.match_id AND tp.player_b = i2.player_id
),
ordered_pairs AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CASE WHEN score_a > score_b OR (score_a = score_b AND player_a > player_b) THEN player_a ELSE player_b END as player_1,
           CASE WHEN score_a > score_b OR (score_a = score_b AND player_a > player_b) THEN player_b ELSE player_a END as player_2,
           CASE WHEN score_a > score_b OR (score_a = score_b AND player_a > player_b) THEN score_a ELSE score_b END as player_1_score,
           CASE WHEN score_a > score_b OR (score_a = score_b AND player_a > player_b) THEN score_b ELSE score_a END as player_2_score,
           partnership_runs
    FROM with_scores
)
SELECT match_id, player_1, player_2, 
       CAST(player_1_score AS INTEGER) as player_1_score, 
       CAST(player_2_score AS INTEGER) as player_2_score, 
       CAST(partnership_runs AS INTEGER) as partnership_score
FROM ordered_pairs
ORDER BY match_id, partnership_score DESC

WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    ts.min_ms,
    ts.max_ms,
    ts.avg_ms,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.min_ms + ts.avg_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.avg_ms + ts.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN track_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  tc.category,
  ROUND(MIN(tc.duration_minutes), 2) as min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(tc.duration_minutes), 2) as max_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity, 0)), 2) as total_revenue
FROM track_classified tc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY tc.category
ORDER BY 
  CASE tc.category 
    WHEN 'Short' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Long' THEN 3 
  END

  Salary,
  TRY_CAST(
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(Salary, '/(yr|mo|hr)', ''),
        ',', '', 'g'
      ),
      '[^0-9.]', ''
    ) AS DOUBLE
  ) AS cleaned_numeric,
  CASE 
    WHEN Salary LIKE '%/mo' THEN 'monthly'
    WHEN Salary LIKE '%/yr' THEN 'yearly'
    WHEN Salary LIKE '%/hr' THEN 'hourly'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS freq_type
FROM SalaryDataset 
WHERE Salary NOT LIKE '₹%'
LIMIT 30

    SELECT 
        CompanyName,
        Location,
        CASE WHEN Salary LIKE '%/mo' 
            THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Salary, '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/yr', ''), '/mo', '') AS DOUBLE) * 12 
            ELSE TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Salary, '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/yr', ''), '/mo', '') AS DOUBLE) 
        END as annual_salary
    FROM SalaryDataset
),
city_company_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        AVG(annual_salary) as avg_salary_city
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
national_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(annual_salary) as avg_salary_national
    FROM cleaned
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Location,
        c.CompanyName,
        c.avg_salary_city,
        n.avg_salary_national,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Location ORDER BY c.avg_salary_city DESC) as rn

)
SELECT

    CompanyName,
    ROUND(avg_salary_city, 2) as "Average Salary in State",

-- Check total number of bowlers
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT bowler FROM ball_by_ball WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bowler)

-- Check how many bowlers have bowled but taken 0 wickets
SELECT COUNT(*) as bowlers_with_no_wickets
FROM (
    SELECT b.bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    EXCEPT
    SELECT bb.bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON bb.match_id = w.match_id AND bb.over_id = w.over_id AND bb.ball_id = w.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = w.innings_no
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
)

-- Count total rows
WITH bowler_balls AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, b.innings_no,
           COUNT(*) as balls_bowled, 
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id, b.innings_no
),
bowler_match AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, 
           SUM(balls_bowled) as balls_bowled, 
           SUM(runs_conceded) as runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_balls
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN wicket_taken w 
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
      AND w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT bowler,
           SUM(balls_bowled) as total_balls,
           SUM(runs_conceded) as total_runs
    FROM bowler_match
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_wicket_totals AS (
    SELECT bowler, SUM(wickets) as total_wickets
    FROM bowler_wickets
    GROUP BY bowler
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT w.bowler, w.match_id, w.wickets, bm.runs_conceded as runs_given
    FROM bowler_wickets w
    JOIN bowler_match bm ON w.bowler = bm.bowler AND w.match_id = bm.match_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.bowler ORDER BY w.wickets DESC, w.match_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_bowlers
FROM bowler_totals bt
JOIN bowler_wicket_totals btw ON bt.bowler = btw.bowler
LEFT JOIN player p ON bt.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN best_bowling bb ON bt.bowler = bb.bowler

-- Verify economy rate for Malinga (194)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as balls,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(bs.runs_scored) / (COUNT(*) / 6.0), 2) as economy
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
WHERE b.bowler = 194

-- Final clean query
WITH bowler_balls AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id, b.innings_no
),
bowler_match_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN wicket_taken w 
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = w.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL 
        AND w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id, b.innings_no
),
bowler_match_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.balls_bowled,
        bb.runs_conceded,
        COALESCE(bmw.wickets, 0) as wickets
    FROM bowler_balls bb
    LEFT JOIN bowler_match_wickets bmw 
        ON bb.bowler = bmw.bowler 
        AND bb.match_id = bmw.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bmw.innings_no
),
bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        SUM(balls_bowled) as total_balls,
        SUM(runs_conceded) as total_runs,
        SUM(wickets) as total_wickets
    FROM bowler_match_stats
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_best_match AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (bowler)
        bowler,
        wickets,
        runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_match_stats
    ORDER BY bowler, wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST(bt.total_wickets AS INTEGER) as total_wickets,
    ROUND(1.0 * bt.total_runs / bt.total_balls * 6, 2) as economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN bt.total_wickets > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * bt.total_balls / bt.total_wickets, 2) ELSE NULL END as strike_rate,
    bm.wickets || '-' || TRY_CAST(bm.runs_conceded AS INTEGER) as best_bowling
FROM bowler_totals bt
JOIN bowler_best_match bm ON bt.bowler = bm.bowler
JOIN player p ON bt.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bt.total_wickets DESC, economy_rate ASC

    SELECT p.player_id
    FROM player p

-- Batting stats properly separated
WITH batting_per_match AS (
  SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, bbb.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as match_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bbb
  JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bbs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bbs.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
batting_totals AS (
  SELECT player_id,
    SUM(match_runs) as total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100plus,
    MAX(match_runs) as highest_score
  FROM batting_per_match
  GROUP BY player_id
),
balls_faced AS (
  SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
  FROM ball_by_ball bbb
  JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bbs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bbs.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbb.striker
)
SELECT bt.player_id, bt.total_runs, bf.balls_faced, bt.highest_score, bt.matches_30plus, bt.matches_50plus, bt.matches_100plus
FROM batting_totals bt
JOIN balls_faced bf ON bt.player_id = bf.player_id
ORDER BY bt.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Check all matches for player 3
SELECT pm.match_id, pm.role, 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ball_by_ball b WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = 3) as striker_balls
FROM player_match pm
WHERE pm.player_id = 3

-- Full query with LEFT JOIN for most_frequent_role to include all players
WITH most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM player_match
        GROUP BY player_id, role
    )
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) = 1
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
player_highest_score AS (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(match_runs) as highest_score
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_score_thresholds AS (
    SELECT player_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_balls_faced AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),
player_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON wt.match_id = b.match_id AND wt.over_id = b.over_id AND wt.ball_id = b.ball_id AND wt.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
player_runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
player_balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),
player_best_bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given
    FROM (
        SELECT b.bowler as player_id, b.match_id, COUNT(*) as wickets, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_given,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.bowler ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(bs.runs_scored) ASC) as rn
        FROM wicket_taken wt
        JOIN ball_by_ball b ON wt.match_id = b.match_id AND wt.over_id = b.over_id AND wt.ball_id = b.ball_id AND wt.innings_no = b.innings_no
        JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(mfr.role, 'Player') as most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    COALESCE(pm.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / pd.total_dismissals, 2) ELSE NULL END as batting_average,
    phs.highest_score,
    COALESCE(pst.matches_30, 0) as matches_30,
    COALESCE(pst.matches_50, 0) as matches_50,
    COALESCE(pst.matches_100, 0) as matches_100,
    COALESCE(pbf.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pbf.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / pbf.total_balls_faced * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(pw.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pbbow.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * prc.total_runs_conceded / pbbow.total_balls_bowled * 6, 2) ELSE NULL END as economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN pbb.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(pbb.wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(pbb.runs_given AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END as best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_highest_score phs ON p.player_id = phs.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_score_thresholds pst ON p.player_id = pst.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_balls_faced pbf ON p.player_id = pbf.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_wickets pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs_conceded prc ON p.player_id = prc.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_balls_bowled pbbow ON p.player_id = pbbow.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_best_bowling pbb ON p.player_id = pbb.player_id
LIMIT 10

-- Final answer: problems where stack_beat_count > solution_count
SELECT s.name, 
       s.solution_count,
       m.stack_beat_count
FROM (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
) s
JOIN (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as stack_beat_count
    FROM (
        SELECT name, version, step, 
               MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
               MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_non_stack_score
        FROM model_score
        GROUP BY name, version, step
        HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) > MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END)
    )
    GROUP BY name
) m ON s.name = m.name
WHERE m.stack_beat_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY m.stack_beat_count DESC

    ) sub

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.condition_count, 0) > COALESCE(s.solution_count, 0) THEN 'EXCEEDS' ELSE 'no' END as exceeds

-- Final answer: problems where qualifying count exceeds solution count
WITH stack_comparison AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
    HAVING stack_score IS NOT NULL
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT name, version, step
    FROM stack_comparison
    WHERE max_non_stack_score < stack_score
),
qualified_count AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as qualified_count
    FROM qualified
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_count AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT q.name
FROM qualified_count q
JOIN solution_count s ON q.name = s.name
WHERE q.qualified_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY q.name
