-- Now calculate the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT p.id AS root_id, p.id AS current_id, CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT h.root_id, pr.contains_id AS current_id, h.cumulative_qty * CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT h.root_id, SUM(h.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY h.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM root_totals;

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
    pr.contains_id AS current_id,
    pr.qty AS level_qty,
    1 AS depth
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations EXCEPT SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pt.level_qty * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaf_ids AS (
  SELECT contains_id AS leaf_id FROM packaging_relations
  EXCEPT
  SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
),
leaf_quantities AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    SUM(pt.level_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN leaf_ids li ON li.leaf_id = pt.current_id
  GROUP BY pt.top_id
)
SELECT top_id, total_leaf_qty FROM leaf_quantities ORDER BY top_id

-- Aggregate total quantities per top-level container per leaf item
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS total_qty_so_far
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (531, 532, 533, 534)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.total_qty_so_far * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
)
SELECT 
    p_top.name AS top_container,
    p_leaf.name AS leaf_item,
    SUM(h.total_qty_so_far) AS total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p_top ON p_top.id = h.top_id
JOIN packaging p_leaf ON p_leaf.id = h.current_id
WHERE h.current_id IN (501, 502)
GROUP BY p_top.name, p_leaf.name
HAVING SUM(h.total_qty_so_far) > 500
ORDER BY p_top.name, p_leaf.name

-- Let me build this properly with a recursive CTE to compute the full hierarchy
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: top-level packaging (not contained in anything)
    SELECT 
        p.id as top_id,
        p.name as top_name,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        p2.name as current_name,
        pr.qty as qty,
        1 as level
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find what the current item contains
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr2.contains_id,
        p3.name,
        h.qty * pr2.qty,
        h.level + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr2 ON h.current_id = pr2.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p3 ON pr2.contains_id = p3.id
)
SELECT 
    h.top_id,
    h.top_name,
    h.current_id as item_id,
    h.current_name as item_name,
    SUM(h.qty) as total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)  -- leaf nodes
GROUP BY h.top_id, h.top_name, h.current_id, h.current_name

ORDER BY h.top_id, h.current_id

WITH order_lines AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
  FROM orderlines
  WHERE order_id = 423
  GROUP BY product_id
),
inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) AS rn
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
  WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
inv_with_cum AS (
  SELECT inv.*, 
    SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased, inv.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_qty,
    SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased, inv.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) - inv.qty AS prev_cumulative_qty
  FROM inv
)
SELECT 
  inv.product_id,
  inv.aisle,
  inv.position,
  CASE 
    WHEN inv.prev_cumulative_qty >= ol.total_qty THEN 0
    WHEN inv.cumulative_qty <= ol.total_qty THEN inv.qty
    ELSE ol.total_qty - inv.prev_cumulative_qty
  END AS qty_to_pick
FROM inv_with_cum inv
JOIN order_lines ol ON inv.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE inv.prev_cumulative_qty < ol.total_qty
ORDER BY inv.product_id, inv.purchased, inv.qty

WITH order_needs AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_needed
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id,
        i.product_id,
        i.location_id,
        i.aisle,
        i.position,
        i.qty,
        i.purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id 
            ORDER BY i.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM inventory_with_dims i
    WHERE i.warehouse = 1
    AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_needs)
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.*,
        SUM(inv.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY inv.product_id 
            ORDER BY inv.purchased ASC, inv.qty ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cum_qty,
        o.total_needed
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_needs o ON o.product_id = inv.product_id
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    qty AS available_qty,
    purchased,
    LEAST(qty, total_needed - (cum_qty - qty)) AS picked_qty
FROM cumulative
WHERE cum_qty - qty < total_needed
ORDER BY product_id, purchased, qty

-- Total inventory for 6520 = 400
-- Total ordered for 6520 = 140+80+40+40 = 300
-- So all orders can be fully fulfilled. Average = 100%

-- For 4280: total inventory = 200, total ordered = 480
-- So not all can be fulfilled.

-- Let me now build the full SQL query to calculate this.
-- The approach:
-- 1. For each product, list all inventory entries sorted by purchase_date ASC, qty ASC
-- 2. For each product, list all orders with their orderline quantities sorted by ordered date ASC
-- 3. Simulate FIFO: walk through inventory, fulfill orders in order
-- 4. Calculate pick percentage per order
-- 5. Average per product

-- This requires a window function approach. Let me try using QUALIFY or recursive CTE.

-- Actually, this is complex. Let me try a different approach using running totals.

-- For each product, I need to:
-- 1. Assign a running total of inventory available (cumulative sum of inventory qty in FIFO order)
-- 2. Assign a running total of orders (cumulative sum of order quantities in chronological order)
-- 3. For each order, the amount picked = min(cumulative_inventory_at_that_point, cumulative_order) - cumulative_inventory_before

-- Let me build this step by step.

-- First, let me create a CTE that combines inventory entries with running totals
WITH inv_ordered AS (
    SELECT i.id as inv_id, i.product_id, p.name as product_name,
           i.qty as inv_qty, purch.purchased as purchase_date, i.location_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY purch.purchased, i.qty, i.location_id) as inv_seq
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN purchases purch ON i.purchase_id = purch.id
),
inv_cumulative AS (
    SELECT inv_id, product_id, product_name, inv_qty, purchase_date, location_id, inv_seq,
           SUM(inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY inv_seq) as cumulative_inv
    FROM inv_ordered
),
orders_ordered AS (
    SELECT o.id as order_id, o.ordered, ol.product_id, p.name as product_name, ol.qty as required_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered) as order_seq
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
),
orders_cumulative AS (
    SELECT order_id, ordered, product_id, product_name, required_qty, order_seq,
           SUM(required_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_seq) as cumulative_order
    FROM orders_ordered
)

    GROUP BY o.id, o.ordered, ol.product_id, p.name

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, inv.qty, inv.id) as rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN purchases p ON p.id = inv.purchase_id
),

    SELECT product_id, purchased, qty,
           SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_inv
    FROM inventory

WITH ranked_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.product_id,
        SUM(inv.qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.product_id
),
orderlines_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.id as orderline_id,
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id,
        p.name as product_name,
        ol.qty as order_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id 
            ORDER BY ol.order_id, ol.id
        ) as order_rank,
        SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id 
            ORDER BY ol.order_id, ol.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as cumulative_order
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
),
fifo_allocation AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.*,
        ri.total_inv,
        LEAST(ol.order_qty, GREATEST(0, ri.total_inv - (ol.cumulative_order - ol.order_qty))) as picked_qty
    FROM orderlines_ranked ol
    JOIN ranked_inventory ri ON ol.product_id = ri.product_id
)
SELECT 
    product_name,
    COUNT(*) as num_orders,
    SUM(order_qty) as total_ordered,
    SUM(picked_qty) as total_picked,
    ROUND(SUM(picked_qty) / SUM(order_qty) * 100, 2) as weighted_avg_pct,

           t.total_inv,

    FROM pick_calc
)

    FROM inventory i

    SELECT o.id as order_id, o.ordered, ol.product_id, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered, o.id) as order_seq
    FROM orders o
    JOIN orderlines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id
),
order_with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_qty, order_seq, order_id,
           SUM(order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_ordered
    FROM order_lines_ordered
),
order_with_prev AS (
    SELECT oc.*,
           LAG(cumulative_ordered) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_seq) as prev_cumulative_ordered
    FROM order_with_cumulative oc
),
order_picks AS (
    SELECT op.product_id, p.name, op.order_seq, op.order_id, op.order_qty,
           op.cumulative_ordered, op.prev_cumulative_ordered,
           it.total_inv,
           CASE 
               WHEN op.cumulative_ordered <= it.total_inv THEN op.order_qty
               WHEN op.prev_cumulative_ordered >= it.total_inv THEN 0.0
               ELSE it.total_inv - op.prev_cumulative_ordered
           END as picked_qty,
           CASE 
               WHEN op.cumulative_ordered <= it.total_inv THEN 1.0
               WHEN op.prev_cumulative_ordered >= it.total_inv THEN 0.0
               ELSE (it.total_inv - op.prev_cumulative_ordered) / op.order_qty
           END as pick_pct
    FROM order_with_prev op
    JOIN inv_totals it ON op.product_id = it.product_id
    JOIN products p ON op.product_id = p.id
)

       ROUND(AVG(pick_pct) * 100, 2) as avg_pick_percentage

WITH ordered_sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS mth_num
    FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, mth_num,
           (AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_num ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING) +
            AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_num ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING)) / 2.0 AS cma
    FROM ordered_sales
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, cma,
           qty / cma AS ratio
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE mth >= '2017-01-01' AND mth <= '2017-12-01'
      AND mth_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
product_check AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           MIN(ratio) AS min_ratio,
           COUNT(*) AS month_count
    FROM ratios
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.name
FROM product_check pc
JOIN products p ON pc.product_id = p.id
WHERE pc.min_ratio > 2
  AND pc.month_count = 12

WITH ordered_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS mth_num
  FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    o.product_id,
    o.mth,
    o.qty,
    o.mth_num,
    (SELECT AVG(s1.qty * 1.0) FROM ordered_sales s1 
     WHERE s1.product_id = o.product_id AND s1.mth_num BETWEEN o.mth_num - 5 AND o.mth_num + 6) AS window1_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) FROM ordered_sales s2 
     WHERE s2.product_id = o.product_id AND s2.mth_num BETWEEN o.mth_num - 6 AND o.mth_num + 5) AS window2_avg
  FROM ordered_sales o
  WHERE o.mth_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    qty,
    mth_num,
    (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma,
    qty / ((window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_calc
),
-- Check which products have all 12 months of 2017 with ratio > 2
product_check AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_months,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_to_cma_ratio > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS months_above_2
  FROM with_ratio
  WHERE mth_num BETWEEN 13 AND 24
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  total_months,
  months_above_2,
  CASE WHEN months_above_2 = total_months THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS all_above_2
FROM product_check
ORDER BY product_id

-- See all remaining product data for 2017 (products 5430, 6520, 6600, 7790, 7870, 7950)
WITH ordered_sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as rn
    FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, rn,
           AVG(qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id 
               ORDER BY rn 
               ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING
           ) as avg_window1,
           AVG(qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id 
               ORDER BY rn 
               ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING
           ) as avg_window2
    FROM ordered_sales
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, rn,
           qty / ((avg_window1 + avg_window2) / 2.0) as sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE rn >= 7 AND rn <= 30
)
SELECT product_id, mth, rn, qty, sales_to_cma_ratio
FROM ratios
WHERE rn >= 13 AND rn <= 24
ORDER BY product_id, rn

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id, mth, qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS mth_num
  FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id, mth, qty, mth_num,
    AVG(qty) OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_id 
      ORDER BY mth_num 
      ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING
    ) AS avg_window1,
    AVG(qty) OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_id 
      ORDER BY mth_num 
      ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING
    ) AS avg_window2
  FROM base
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id, mth, qty, mth_num,
    qty / ((avg_window1 + avg_window2) / 2.0) AS ratio
  FROM cma_calc
  WHERE mth_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND mth >= '2017-01-01' 
    AND mth <= '2017-12-01'
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  COUNT(*) AS month_count,
  MIN(ratio) AS min_ratio,
  MAX(ratio) AS max_ratio,
  CASE WHEN MIN(ratio) > 2 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS all_above_2
FROM ratios
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

-- Final complete query for both products
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id, 
    mth, 
    qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) AS month_num
  FROM monthly_sales 
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*,
    (SELECT AVG(b2.qty * 1.0) FROM base b2 
     WHERE b2.product_id = b.product_id AND b2.time_step BETWEEN b.time_step - 5 AND b.time_step + 6) AS window1_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(b2.qty * 1.0) FROM base b2 
     WHERE b2.product_id = b.product_id AND b2.time_step BETWEEN b.time_step - 6 AND b.time_step + 5) AS window2_avg
  FROM base b
),
with_cma AS (
  SELECT *, (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM cma_calc
),
seasonality AS (
  SELECT *, 
         CASE WHEN cma != 0 THEN qty * 1.0 / cma ELSE NULL END AS ratio
  FROM with_cma
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonal_indices AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_num, AVG(ratio) AS seasonal_index
  FROM seasonality
  GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT w.*,
         CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index != 0 AND si.seasonal_index IS NOT NULL THEN w.qty * 1.0 / si.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END AS trend
  FROM with_cma w
  LEFT JOIN seasonal_indices si ON w.product_id = si.product_id AND w.month_num = si.month_num
),
weighted_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(cma) AS sum_w,
    SUM(cma * time_step) AS sum_wx,
    SUM(cma * trend) AS sum_wy,
    SUM(cma * time_step * time_step) AS sum_wxx,
    SUM(cma * time_step * trend) AS sum_wxy
  FROM deseasonalized
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30 AND trend IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    (sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / (sum_w * sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx) AS slope,
    (sum_wy - ((sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / (sum_w * sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx)) * sum_wx) / sum_w AS intercept
  FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    b.product_id,
    b.time_step,
    b.month_num,
    rp.slope,
    rp.intercept,
    rp.slope * b.time_step + rp.intercept AS forecast_trend,
    si.seasonal_index,
    CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index != 0 THEN (rp.slope * b.time_step + rp.intercept) * si.seasonal_index ELSE 0 END AS forecast_qty
  FROM base b
  JOIN regression_params rp ON b.product_id = rp.product_id
  LEFT JOIN seasonal_indices si ON b.product_id = si.product_id AND b.month_num = si.month_num
  WHERE b.time_step BETWEEN 25 AND 36
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_qty), 2) AS avg_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as time_step,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) as month_of_year
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        s.product_id,
        s.mth,
        s.qty,
        s.time_step,
        s.month_of_year,
        (AVG(s2.qty) + AVG(s3.qty)) / 2.0 as cma
    FROM sales s
    LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON s.product_id = s2.product_id 
        AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s.time_step - 5 AND s.time_step + 6
    LEFT JOIN sales s3 ON s.product_id = s3.product_id 
        AND s3.time_step BETWEEN s.time_step - 6 AND s.time_step + 5
    WHERE s.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step, s.month_of_year
),
ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        time_step,
        month_of_year,
        cma,
        qty * 1.0 / cma as sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) as raw_seasonality
    FROM ratio
    GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
normalized_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        raw_seasonality / AVG(raw_seasonality) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) as seasonality_factor
    FROM seasonality
),
deseasonalized AS (
    SELECT 
        s.product_id,
        s.time_step,
        s.month_of_year,
        s.qty,
        ns.seasonality_factor,
        CASE WHEN ns.seasonality_factor > 0 THEN s.qty * 1.0 / ns.seasonality_factor ELSE NULL END as deseasonalized_qty
    FROM sales s
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON s.product_id = ns.product_id AND s.month_of_year = ns.month_of_year
),
weighted_reg AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(time_step) as sum_w,
        SUM(time_step * time_step) as sum_wx,
        SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wy,
        SUM(time_step * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wxy
    FROM deseasonalized
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) as slope,
        (sum_wy - (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) * sum_wx) / sum_w as intercept
    FROM weighted_reg
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        ns.month_of_year,
        ns.seasonality_factor,
        (r.intercept + r.slope * (37 + ns.month_of_year - 1)) * ns.seasonality_factor as forecast_sales
    FROM regression r
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON r.product_id = ns.product_id
),
annual_forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(forecast_sales) as annual_forecast
    FROM forecast
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    ROUND(annual_forecast, 2) as annual_forecast
FROM annual_forecast
ORDER BY product_id

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as time_step,
           EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) as month_num,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) as year_num
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step, s.month_num, s.year_num,
           (
               SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) 
               FROM monthly_sales s2 
               WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id 
               AND CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) 
                   BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 11 
                   AND CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 6
           ) as window1,
           (
               SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) 
               FROM monthly_sales s2 
               WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id 
               AND CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) 
                   BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 12 
                   AND CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 5
           ) as window2
    FROM sales s
),
with_ratio AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, time_step, month_num, year_num,
           (window1 + window2) / 2.0 as cma,
           CASE WHEN (window1 + window2) / 2.0 != 0 THEN qty / ((window1 + window2) / 2.0) ELSE NULL END as ratio
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonal_indices AS (
    SELECT product_id, month_num,
           AVG(ratio) as seasonal_index
    FROM with_ratio
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
deseasonalized AS (
    SELECT s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step, s.month_num, s.year_num, si.seasonal_index,
           CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index != 0 AND si.seasonal_index IS NOT NULL 
                THEN s.qty * 1.0 / si.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END as deseasonalized_qty
    FROM sales s
    JOIN seasonal_indices si ON s.product_id = si.product_id AND s.month_num = si.month_num
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           SUM(time_step) as sum_w,
           SUM(time_step * time_step) as sum_wx,
           SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wy,
           SUM(time_step * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wxy
    FROM deseasonalized
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum_wy * 1.0 / sum_w as y_bar,
           sum_wx * 1.0 / sum_w as x_bar,
           (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy * 1.0 / sum_w) as numerator,
           (sum_wx - sum_wx * sum_wx * 1.0 / sum_w) as denominator
    FROM weighted_stats
),
final_params AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           numerator / denominator as slope,
           y_bar - (numerator / denominator) * x_bar as intercept
    FROM regression_params
)
SELECT product_id, slope, intercept FROM final_params

-- Final answer: average forecasted annual sales for products 4160 and 7790 during 2018
WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as time_step
    FROM monthly_sales 
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.product_id,
        s1.time_step,
        s1.mth,
        s1.qty as actual_sales,
        (AVG(s2.qty) FILTER (WHERE s2.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 5 AND s1.time_step + 6) +
         AVG(s3.qty) FILTER (WHERE s3.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 6 AND s1.time_step + 5)) / 2.0 as cma,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s1.mth::DATE) as month_num
    FROM sales_data s1
    JOIN sales_data s2 ON s2.product_id = s1.product_id AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 5 AND s1.time_step + 6
    JOIN sales_data s3 ON s3.product_id = s1.product_id AND s3.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 6 AND s1.time_step + 5
    WHERE s1.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY s1.product_id, s1.time_step, s1.mth, s1.qty
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(cma) as sum_w,
        SUM(cma * time_step) as sum_wx,
        SUM(cma * cma) as sum_wy,
        SUM(cma * time_step * time_step) as sum_wxx,
        SUM(cma * time_step * cma) as sum_wxy
    FROM cma_calc
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) as slope,
        (sum_wy / sum_w) - (sum_wx / sum_w) * ((sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w)) as intercept
    FROM weighted_stats
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        AVG(CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN 1.0 * actual_sales / cma ELSE NULL END) as raw_factor
    FROM cma_calc
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
norm_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        raw_factor / AVG(raw_factor) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) as seasonality_factor
    FROM seasonality
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        f.time_step,
        (r.slope * f.time_step + r.intercept) * ns.seasonality_factor as forecast_actual
    FROM regression r
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(generate_series(25, 36)) as time_step) f
    JOIN norm_seasonality ns ON ns.product_id = r.product_id 
        AND ns.month_num = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (DATE '2018-01-01' + ((f.time_step - 25) || ' months')::INTERVAL)::DATE)
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    ROUND(SUM(forecast_actual), 2) as average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) AS month_num
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
lagged AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        mth,
        qty,
        month_num,
        LAG(qty, 1) OVER w AS q_m1,
        LAG(qty, 2) OVER w AS q_m2,
        LAG(qty, 3) OVER w AS q_m3,
        LAG(qty, 4) OVER w AS q_m4,
        LAG(qty, 5) OVER w AS q_m5,
        LAG(qty, 6) OVER w AS q_m6,
        LEAD(qty, 1) OVER w AS q_p1,
        LEAD(qty, 2) OVER w AS q_p2,
        LEAD(qty, 3) OVER w AS q_p3,
        LEAD(qty, 4) OVER w AS q_p4,
        LEAD(qty, 5) OVER w AS q_p5,
        LEAD(qty, 6) OVER w AS q_p6
    FROM monthly_data
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY time_step)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        mth,
        qty,
        month_num,
        (2.0 * (q_m5 + q_m4 + q_m3 + q_m2 + q_m1 + qty + q_p1 + q_p2 + q_p3 + q_p4 + q_p5) + q_m6 + q_p6) / 24.0 AS cma
    FROM lagged
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonal AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        mth,
        qty,
        month_num,
        CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN 1.0 * qty / cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
),
seasonal_indices AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS seasonal_index
    FROM seasonal
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
all_data AS (
    SELECT 
        md.product_id,
        md.time_step,
        md.mth,
        md.qty,
        md.month_num,
        si.seasonal_index,
        CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index > 0 THEN 1.0 * md.qty / si.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized
    FROM monthly_data md
    JOIN seasonal_indices si ON md.product_id = si.product_id AND md.month_num = si.month_num
),
-- Use CMA as weights for steps 7-30, and 1 for other steps
weighted_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.product_id,
        ad.time_step,
        ad.deseasonalized,
        COALESCE(cc.cma, 1.0) AS weight
    FROM all_data ad
    LEFT JOIN cma_calc cc ON ad.product_id = cc.product_id AND ad.time_step = cc.time_step
    WHERE ad.deseasonalized IS NOT NULL
),
weighted_means AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(weight * time_step) / SUM(weight) AS x_mean,
        SUM(weight * deseasonalized) / SUM(weight) AS y_mean
    FROM weighted_data
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        wd.product_id,
        SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.deseasonalized - wm.y_mean)) / 
            SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean)) AS slope,
        wm.y_mean - 
            SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.deseasonalized - wm.y_mean)) / 
            SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean)) * wm.x_mean AS intercept
    FROM weighted_data wd
    JOIN weighted_means wm ON wd.product_id = wm.product_id
    GROUP BY wd.product_id, wm.x_mean, wm.y_mean
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        r.slope,
        r.intercept,
        si.seasonal_index,
        si.month_num,
        (r.intercept + r.slope * (36 + si.month_num)) * si.seasonal_index AS forecast_monthly_sales
    FROM regression r
    JOIN seasonal_indices si ON r.product_id = si.product_id
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    ROUND(SUM(forecast_monthly_sales), 2) AS forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, qty, time_step,
        LAG(qty, 1) OVER w AS lag1, LAG(qty, 2) OVER w AS lag2,
        LAG(qty, 3) OVER w AS lag3, LAG(qty, 4) OVER w AS lag4,
        LAG(qty, 5) OVER w AS lag5, LAG(qty, 6) OVER w AS lag6,
        LEAD(qty, 1) OVER w AS lead1, LEAD(qty, 2) OVER w AS lead2,
        LEAD(qty, 3) OVER w AS lead3, LEAD(qty, 4) OVER w AS lead4,
        LEAD(qty, 5) OVER w AS lead5, LEAD(qty, 6) OVER w AS lead6
    FROM monthly_data
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY time_step)
),
with_cma AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, qty, time_step,
        (COALESCE(lag5,0) + COALESCE(lag4,0) + COALESCE(lag3,0) + COALESCE(lag2,0) + COALESCE(lag1,0) + qty + COALESCE(lead1,0) + COALESCE(lead2,0) + COALESCE(lead3,0) + COALESCE(lead4,0) + COALESCE(lead5,0) + COALESCE(lead6,0) 
         + COALESCE(lag6,0) + COALESCE(lag5,0) + COALESCE(lag4,0) + COALESCE(lag3,0) + COALESCE(lag2,0) + COALESCE(lag1,0) + qty + COALESCE(lead1,0) + COALESCE(lead2,0) + COALESCE(lead3,0) + COALESCE(lead4,0) + COALESCE(lead5,0) + lead6) / 24.0 AS cma
    FROM with_windows
),
with_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, qty, time_step, cma,
        CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN qty * 1.0 / cma ELSE NULL END AS ratio,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) AS month_of_year
    FROM with_cma
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM with_ratio
    GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
seasonality_norm AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        avg_ratio * 12.0 / SUM(avg_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS norm_ratio
    FROM seasonality
),
all_data AS (
    SELECT 
        md.product_id, md.mth, md.qty, md.time_step,
        sn.norm_ratio AS seasonality_index,
        CASE WHEN sn.norm_ratio > 0 THEN md.qty * 1.0 / sn.norm_ratio ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized_qty,
        wc.cma
    FROM monthly_data md
    JOIN seasonality_norm sn ON md.product_id = sn.product_id AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(md.mth AS DATE)) = sn.month_of_year
    LEFT JOIN with_cma wc ON md.product_id = wc.product_id AND md.mth = wc.mth
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(cma) AS W,
        SUM(cma * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wxy,
        SUM(cma * time_step * time_step) AS sum_wxx,
        SUM(cma * time_step) AS sum_wx,
        SUM(cma * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wy
    FROM all_data
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
weighted_regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wy) / (sum_wxx - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wx) AS slope,
        (sum_wy / W) - (sum_wx / W) * ((sum_wxy - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wy) / (sum_wxx - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wx)) AS intercept
    FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast_months AS (
    SELECT product_id, month_of_year, norm_ratio FROM seasonality_norm
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.product_id,
        fm.month_of_year,
        fm.norm_ratio AS seasonality_index,
        ROUND((wr.intercept + wr.slope * (24 + fm.month_of_year)) * fm.norm_ratio, 2) AS forecasted_monthly
    FROM weighted_regression wr
    JOIN forecast_months fm ON wr.product_id = fm.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, 
       ROUND(SUM(forecasted_monthly), 2) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

ORDER BY product_id, mth

-- Find the month with the smallest absolute difference for each product in 2019
WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model AS (
    SELECT 
        it.product_id,
        CAST('2018-12-01' AS DATE) as mth,
        it.qty as ending_inv,
        pm.qty_minimum,
        pm.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_totals it
    JOIN product_minimums pm ON it.product_id = pm.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        CAST(DATE_ADD(im.mth, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS DATE) as mth,
        CASE 
            WHEN (im.ending_inv - CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE)) < im.qty_minimum 
            THEN im.ending_inv - CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) + im.qty_purchase
            ELSE im.ending_inv - CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE)
        END as ending_inv,
        im.qty_minimum,
        im.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_model im
    JOIN monthly_budget mb ON im.product_id = mb.product_id 
        AND CAST(mb.mth AS DATE) = CAST(DATE_ADD(im.mth, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS DATE)
    WHERE im.mth < CAST('2019-12-01' AS DATE)
),
monthly_results AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, ending_inv, qty_minimum, ABS(ending_inv - qty_minimum) as abs_diff
    FROM inventory_model
    WHERE mth >= CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE)
)
SELECT product_id, mth, ROUND(abs_diff, 2) as abs_diff
FROM monthly_results
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) = 1
ORDER BY product_id

           DATE '2019-01-01' + (month_num * INTERVAL '1 month') as mth

        p.product_id,
        0 as step_num,
        '2018-12-01' as mth,

    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM product_minimums) p
    JOIN inventory_totals it ON p.product_id = it.product_id

    SELECT 
        b.product_id,
        b.step_num,
        b.mth,
        b.ending_inv
    FROM base b

    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        im.step_num + 1,
        md.mth,
        CASE 
            WHEN im.ending_inv - mb.qty < pm.qty_minimum 
            THEN im.ending_inv - mb.qty + pm.qty_purchase
            ELSE im.ending_inv - mb.qty
        END as ending_inv

    JOIN monthly_budget mb ON im.product_id = mb.product_id AND md.mth = mb.mth

WITH team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        t.team_long_name AS team_name,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
                WHEN t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
                WHEN t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
                WHEN t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        )::INTEGER AS total_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
    GROUP BY m.season, l.name, c.name, t.team_long_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season, league, country, team_name, total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT season, league, country, team_name, total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, league

WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        t1.team_long_name AS home_team,
        t2.team_long_name AS away_team,
        m.home_team_goal,
        m.away_team_goal,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3 
             WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 END AS home_points,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3 
             WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 END AS away_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t1 ON m.home_team_api_id = t1.team_api_id
    JOIN Team t2 ON m.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
),
team_season_points AS (
    SELECT season, league, country, home_team AS team, SUM(home_points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league, country, home_team
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season, league, country, away_team AS team, SUM(away_points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league, country, away_team
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT season, league, country, team, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT season, league, country, team, CAST(total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, league

WITH items AS (
  SELECT 
    item_code,
    item_name,
    "loss_rate_%" AS lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(lr) AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV(lr) AS std_dev_loss_rate
  FROM items
)
SELECT 
  s.avg_loss_rate,
  s.std_dev_loss_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.lr < s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 END) AS count_below,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.lr >= s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate 
              AND i.lr <= s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 END) AS count_within,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.lr > s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 END) AS count_above,
  COUNT(*) AS total_items
FROM items i, stats s
GROUP BY s.avg_loss_rate, s.std_dev_loss_rate

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
  ANY_VALUE(s.avg_loss_rate) AS avg_loss_rate,
  ANY_VALUE(s.stddev_loss_rate) AS stddev_loss_rate,
  ANY_VALUE(s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) AS lower_bound,
  ANY_VALUE(s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) AS upper_bound,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) AS below_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v."loss_rate_%" >= s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate AND v."loss_rate_%" <= s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) AS within_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) AS above_count,
  COUNT(*) AS total_items
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_lr, STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as std_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
item_classes AS (
  SELECT 
    v.item_code,
    v.item_name,
    v."loss_rate_%",
    s.avg_lr,
    s.std_lr,
    s.avg_lr - s.std_lr as lower_bound,
    s.avg_lr + s.std_lr as upper_bound,
    CASE 
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_lr - s.std_lr THEN 'below'
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_lr + s.std_lr THEN 'above'
      ELSE 'within'
    END as category
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((SELECT avg_lr FROM stats), 4) as avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'below' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_below,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'within' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_within,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'above' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_above,
  COUNT(*) as total_items
FROM item_classes

    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(w.whsle_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(w.whsle_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE))::INT, c.category_name, c.item_code
),
wholesale_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        year,

        ROUND(AVG(avg_wholesale_price), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,

        ROUND(MIN(min_wholesale_price), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(max_wholesale_price) - MIN(min_wholesale_price), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(total_wholesale_price), 2) as total_wholesale_price
    FROM wholesale

),
selling AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE))::INT as year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t."sale/return" = 'sale' THEN t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" ELSE 0 END), 2) as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t

    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE))::INT, c.category_name
),
loss AS (

        ROUND(AVG(l."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)

FROM wholesale_stats ws

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
),
with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance
    FROM with_balance
),
most_recent AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start AS most_recent_month,
        closing_balance,
        prev_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM with_prev
    WHERE month_start = (SELECT MAX(month_start) FROM with_balance wb WHERE wb.customer_id = with_prev.customer_id)
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total,
    COUNT(growth_rate) as with_rate,

customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as min_date, MAX(txn_date) as max_date
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT customer_id, min_date, max_date,
           (SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(0, (max_date - min_date)::INTEGER)) as day_offsets
    FROM customer_date_range
),
daily_balance AS (
    SELECT ad.customer_id, 
           CAST(ad.min_date + CAST(u.day_offset AS INTEGER) AS DATE) as txn_date, 
           COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
    FROM all_dates ad
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT UNNEST(ad.day_offsets) as day_offset) u
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id 
        AND CAST(ad.min_date + CAST(u.day_offset AS INTEGER) AS DATE) = dn.txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net,
           SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as balance
    FROM daily_balance
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as day_number,
           AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_30d
    FROM running_balance
),
filtered_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           GREATEST(rolling_avg_30d, 0) as rolling_avg_30d
    FROM rolling_avg
    WHERE day_number >= 30
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, rolling_avg_30d,
           date_trunc('month', txn_date) as month_start
    FROM filtered_avg
),
customer_first_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(date_trunc('month', txn_date)) as first_month
    FROM filtered_avg
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
max_per_month AS (
    SELECT wm.customer_id, wm.month_start,
           MAX(wm.rolling_avg_30d) as max_30d_avg
    FROM with_month wm
    JOIN customer_first_month cfm ON wm.customer_id = cfm.customer_id
    WHERE wm.month_start > cfm.first_month
    GROUP BY wm.customer_id, wm.month_start
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT month_start, SUM(max_30d_avg) as total_max_30d_avg
    FROM max_per_month
    GROUP BY month_start
)

WITH daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
             WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
             ELSE 0 END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
date_ranges AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date)::DATE as earliest, MAX(txn_date)::DATE as latest
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, earliest, latest,
    (date_trunc('day', earliest::DATE) + (seq * INTERVAL '1 day'))::DATE as txn_date
  FROM date_ranges,
    UNNEST(generate_series(0, (latest - earliest)::INTEGER)) AS seq(seq)
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.txn_date, COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net,
    SUM(COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.customer_id ORDER BY ad.txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dn.txn_date
),

  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, GREATEST(running_balance, 0) as daily_balance

),
monthly_max AS (

    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date)::INTEGER as year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date)::INTEGER as month,

  GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date)::INTEGER, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date)::INTEGER

WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date::DATE as txn_date, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           MIN(txn_date)::DATE as earliest_date, 
           MAX(txn_date)::DATE as latest_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT cr.customer_id, UNNEST(generate_series(cr.earliest_date, cr.latest_date, INTERVAL '1' DAY)) as cal_date
    FROM customer_ranges cr
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.cal_date, 
           COALESCE(dn.net_amount, 0) as daily_change
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.cal_date = dn.txn_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_change,
           SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as raw_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
clamped_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, 
           GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM cumulative_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date) as month,
           MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM clamped_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date)
)

WITH driver_points AS (
  SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_driver_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
constructor_points AS (
  SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_constructor_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
driver_max AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_driver_points) AS max_driver_points
  FROM driver_points
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_max AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_constructor_points) AS max_constructor_points
  FROM constructor_points
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT dm.year, dm.max_driver_points, cm.max_constructor_points, dm.max_driver_points + cm.max_constructor_points AS combined_total
FROM driver_max dm
JOIN constructor_max cm ON dm.year = cm.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, rd.driver_id, SUM(rd.points) AS driver_points
    FROM results rd
    JOIN races r ON rd.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, rd.driver_id
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, rd.constructor_id, SUM(rd.points) AS constructor_points
    FROM results rd
    JOIN races r ON rd.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, rd.constructor_id
),
max_driver AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_points) AS max_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_points) AS max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT md.year, md.max_driver_points, mc.max_constructor_points, md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points AS combined_total
FROM max_driver md
JOIN max_constructor mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3

-- Step 3: Build the full query to find the 3 years with smallest combined total
WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, driver_id, SUM(results.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM results
    JOIN races r ON results.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, driver_id
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, constructor_id, SUM(results.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results
    JOIN races r ON results.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, constructor_id
),
max_driver_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total_points) as max_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total_points) as max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    md.year,
    md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points as combined_total
FROM max_driver_by_year md
JOIN max_constructor_by_year mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3

-- Get top 3 combined points
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) as max_round
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
last_races AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round
    FROM races r
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON r.year = lry.year AND r.round = lry.max_round
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.race_id
),
driver_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT res.constructor_id, r.year, res.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname,
           SUM(res.points) as driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY res.constructor_id, r.year, res.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, driver_id, forename, surname, driver_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, constructor_id ORDER BY driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_constructor_points
),
combined AS (
    SELECT csp.year, csp.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, csp.constructor_points,
           bd.driver_id, bd.forename, bd.surname, bd.driver_points,
           csp.constructor_points + bd.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN best_driver bd ON csp.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND csp.year = bd.year AND bd.rn = 1
    JOIN constructors c ON csp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name as constructor_name, cy.year, cy.combined
FROM (
    SELECT fc.constructor_id, fc.year, fc.constructor_points, bd.best_driver_points, 
           fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
        FROM constructor_standings cs
        JOIN (SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id FROM races GROUP BY year) lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    ) fc
    JOIN (
        SELECT drv_constructor_id as constructor_id, year, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
        FROM (
            SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points as driver_points, d.constructor_id as drv_constructor_id
            FROM driver_standings ds
            JOIN (SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id FROM races GROUP BY year) lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
            JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND lr.year = d.year
        )
        GROUP BY drv_constructor_id, year
    ) bd ON fc.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND fc.year = bd.year
) cy
JOIN constructors c ON cy.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE cy.rn <= 3
ORDER BY cy.combined DESC

    SELECT cs.race_id, lr.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points as constr_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
),

    SELECT tdr.year, tdr.constructor_id, tdr.driver_id, 
           TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as tdr_rank
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    WHERE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT ds.race_id, lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
)
SELECT cs.constructor_name, cs.year, cs.constr_points,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as best_driver_name, ds.driver_points,
       cs.constr_points + ds.driver_points as combined_points
FROM constructor_season cs
JOIN best_driver bd ON cs.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND cs.year = bd.year
JOIN driver_season ds ON bd.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND cs.year = ds.year
JOIN drivers d ON bd.driver_id = d.driver_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (cs.constr_points + ds.driver_points) DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC;

WITH normalized AS (

        CASE WHEN path = '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(path, '/') END AS path
    FROM activity_log
),

    SELECT DISTINCT session, path
    FROM normalized
    WHERE (session, stamp) IN (
        SELECT session, MIN(stamp)
        FROM normalized
        GROUP BY session
    )
),

    SELECT DISTINCT session, path
    FROM normalized
    WHERE (session, stamp) IN (
        SELECT session, MAX(stamp)
        FROM normalized
        GROUP BY session
    )
),
page_sessions AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM landing

-- Final answer: count unique sessions per page where page is landing or exit
WITH distinct_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, path
    FROM activity_log
),
landing AS (
    SELECT session, path as page
    FROM distinct_activity
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) = 1
),
exit_pages AS (
    SELECT session, path as page
    FROM distinct_activity
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC, path DESC) = 1
),
page_sessions AS (
    SELECT session, page FROM landing
    UNION
    SELECT session, page FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT page, COUNT(*) as unique_sessions
FROM page_sessions
GROUP BY page
ORDER BY page;

-- Final answer: total number of unique user sessions where each web page appears as landing or exit
WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, path
  FROM activity_log
),
landing AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, path
  FROM deduped d
  WHERE stamp = (SELECT MIN(stamp) FROM deduped WHERE session = d.session)
),
exit_pages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, path
  FROM deduped d
  WHERE stamp = (SELECT MAX(stamp) FROM deduped WHERE session = d.session)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT session, path FROM landing
  UNION ALL
  SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) as session_count
FROM combined
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY session_count DESC, path

    SELECT r1.session, r1.rn as pair_start_rn,
           r3.rn as third_rn, r3.path as third_path
    FROM ranked r1
    JOIN ranked r2 ON r1.session = r2.session AND r2.rn = r1.rn + 1
    JOIN ranked r3 ON r1.session = r3.session AND r3.rn = r1.rn + 2
    WHERE (r1.path = '/detail' OR r1.path = '/detail/')
      AND (r2.path = '/detail' OR r2.path = '/detail/')
      AND (r3.path != '/detail' AND r3.path != '/detail/')
)

-- For each race and each lap transition (0->1, 1->2, 2->3, 3->4, 4->5),
-- find all overtakes using the adjacent positions approach
-- This is more efficient because we only look at adjacent positions

-- Let's first test with race 18, lap 0->1
-- For each position p on lap 0, get driver at p and driver at p+1
-- On lap 1, if driver at p+1 is now ahead of driver at p, that's an overtake

WITH lap0 AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position FROM lap_positions WHERE race_id = 18 AND lap = 0
),
lap1 AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position FROM lap_positions WHERE race_id = 18 AND lap = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race'
),
adjacent_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a.driver_id AS driver_a,
        b.driver_id AS driver_b,
        a.position AS pos_a,
        b.position AS pos_b  -- pos_b = pos_a + 1
    FROM lap0 a
    JOIN lap0 b ON a.position + 1 = b.position
)
SELECT 
    ap.driver_a,
    ap.driver_b,
    ap.pos_a,
    ap.pos_b,
    l1a.position AS lap1_pos_a,
    l1b.position AS lap1_pos_b
FROM adjacent_pairs ap
JOIN lap1 l1a ON l1a.driver_id = ap.driver_a
JOIN lap1 l1b ON l1b.driver_id = ap.driver_b
WHERE l1a.position > l1b.position  -- driver_b overtook driver_a
LIMIT 30

-- For race 1, how many drivers have positions on lap 1

-- For race 1, let's check grid vs lap 1 positions
SELECT g.driver_id as g_driver, g.grid_pos, l.lap1_pos
FROM (SELECT driver_id, position as grid_pos FROM lap_positions WHERE lap = 0 AND race_id = 1) g
JOIN (SELECT driver_id, position as lap1_pos FROM lap_positions WHERE lap = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race' AND race_id = 1) l
    ON g.driver_id = l.driver_id
LIMIT 10;

-- Let me think about this more carefully.
-- For lap 1 overtakes, compare lap 0 (grid) to lap 1 positions.
-- An overtake occurs when driver A's position improved relative to driver B.
-- 
-- Actually, the simplest way: for each pair of consecutive laps, 
-- find all (driver_A, driver_B) pairs where:
--   - A was behind B on lap N-1: pos_A_N-1 > pos_B_N-1
--   - A is ahead of B on lap N: pos_A_N < pos_B_N
-- This means A overtook B.
--
-- But this is O(n^2) per race. Let me think of a simpler approach.
--
-- Alternative: For each driver, count position gains between consecutive laps.
-- Each position gain = one overtake.
-- Then we need to identify who was overtaken for classification.
--
-- Let me first check: for lap 1, how many overtakes happened in race 18?
-- Compare grid positions (lap 0) to lap 1 positions.
-- 
-- For race 18, let's see all position changes from grid to lap 1
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position as grid_pos
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id = 18 AND lap = 0
),
lap1 AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position as lap1_pos
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id = 18 AND lap = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race'
)
SELECT g.driver_id, g.grid_pos, l.lap1_pos, g.grid_pos - l.lap1_pos as pos_change
FROM grid g
JOIN lap1 l ON g.driver_id = l.driver_id
WHERE g.grid_pos != l.lap1_pos
ORDER BY pos_change DESC

  AND MIN(CASE WHEN dr.rn_asc = 1 THEN dr.constructor_id END) = MIN(CASE WHEN dr.rn_desc = 1 THEN dr.constructor_id END)

  SELECT 
    rc.year,

  WHERE rc.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959

WITH driver_race_info AS (

    WHERE rac.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT 
        dri.year, dri.driver_id,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_info d1 WHERE d1.year = dri.year AND d1.driver_id = dri.driver_id AND d1.rn_asc = 1) as first_constructor,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_info d2 WHERE d2.year = dri.year AND d2.driver_id = dri.driver_id AND d2.rn_desc = 1) as last_constructor,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dri.round) as num_rounds
    FROM driver_race_info dri
    GROUP BY dri.year, dri.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dri.round) >= 2
)

FROM first_last fl

WHERE fl.first_constructor = fl.last_constructor

WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT ra.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id, ra.round
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_round AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_round
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
last_round AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MAX(round) AS last_round
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_constructor AS (
    SELECT rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
    FROM race_data rd
    JOIN first_round fr ON rd.year = fr.year AND rd.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND rd.round = fr.first_round
    GROUP BY rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
),
last_constructor AS (
    SELECT rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
    FROM race_data rd
    JOIN last_round lr ON rd.year = lr.year AND rd.driver_id = lr.driver_id AND rd.round = lr.last_round
    GROUP BY rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
),
round_counts AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS num_rounds
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.year, fc.driver_id, fc.constructor_id AS first_constructor, lc.constructor_id AS last_constructor, rc.num_rounds
    FROM first_constructor fc
    JOIN last_constructor lc ON fc.year = lc.year AND fc.driver_id = lc.driver_id
    JOIN round_counts rc ON fc.year = rc.year AND fc.driver_id = rc.driver_id
    WHERE fc.constructor_id = lc.constructor_id
      AND rc.num_rounds >= 2
)

-- Full corrected query
WITH hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, first_round as hiatus_first, last_round as hiatus_last,
           (last_round - first_round + 1) as races_missed
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id = -1
),
all_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
hiatus_ranks AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, h.races_missed, h.hiatus_first, h.hiatus_last,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.year, h.driver_id ORDER BY h.hiatus_first) as hrn
    FROM hiatuses h
),
prev_drives AS (
    SELECT h.hrn, a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id, a.last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.year, h.driver_id, h.hrn ORDER BY a.last_round DESC) as rn
    FROM all_drives a
    JOIN hiatus_ranks h ON a.year = h.year AND a.driver_id = h.driver_id
    WHERE a.last_round < h.hiatus_first
),
next_drives AS (
    SELECT h.hrn, a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id, a.first_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.year, h.driver_id, h.hrn ORDER BY a.first_round ASC) as rn
    FROM all_drives a
    JOIN hiatus_ranks h ON a.year = h.year AND a.driver_id = h.driver_id
    WHERE a.first_round > h.hiatus_last
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, h.races_missed, h.hiatus_first, h.hiatus_last,
           p.constructor_id as prev_constructor, n.constructor_id as next_constructor
    FROM hiatus_ranks h
    LEFT JOIN prev_drives p ON h.year = p.year AND h.driver_id = p.driver_id AND h.hrn = p.hrn AND p.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN next_drives n ON h.year = n.year AND h.driver_id = n.driver_id AND h.hrn = n.hrn AND n.rn = 1
    WHERE p.constructor_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND n.constructor_id IS NOT NULL
      AND p.constructor_id != n.constructor_id
      AND h.races_missed < 3
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * hiatus_first) as avg_first_round,
    AVG(1.0 * hiatus_last) as avg_last_round
FROM qualifying

-- Build the full query with the interpretation that we use drives table

WITH multi_stint AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round, drive_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as stint_num
    FROM drives
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.stint_num, a.first_round as prev_first, a.last_round as prev_last, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor,
           b.first_round as next_first, b.last_round as next_last, b.constructor_id as next_constructor
    FROM multi_stint a
    JOIN multi_stint b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.stint_num = b.stint_num - 1
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, 
           prev_last + 1 as hiatus_first_round,
           next_first - 1 as hiatus_last_round,
           next_first - prev_last - 1 as races_missed
    FROM consecutive
)
SELECT * FROM with_gaps
WHERE races_missed > 0 AND races_missed < 3 AND prev_constructor != next_constructor
ORDER BY year, driver_id

-- Final query with more precision
WITH driver_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.rn as rn1, a.first_round as first_round1, a.last_round as last_round1, a.constructor_id as constructor1,
           b.first_round as first_round2, b.last_round as last_round2, b.constructor_id as constructor2
    FROM driver_drives a
    JOIN driver_drives b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, last_round1, first_round2, (first_round2 - last_round1 - 1) as races_missed,
           constructor1, constructor2, constructor1 != constructor2 as switched,
           last_round1 + 1 as first_missed_round,
           first_round2 - 1 as last_missed_round
    FROM consecutive
    WHERE first_round2 > last_round1 + 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(first_missed_round), 4) as avg_first_round,
    ROUND(AVG(last_missed_round), 4) as avg_last_round,
    COUNT(*) as num_instances
FROM hiatuses
WHERE races_missed < 3 AND switched

-- Full query: find drivers overtaken more than they overtook, excluding pit-related changes on exact pit lap
WITH race_positions AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap > 1
),
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap as pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT rp.race_id, rp.driver_id, rp.lap, rp.position, rp.prev_position,
           rp.position - rp.prev_position as pos_change,
           CASE WHEN ps.pit_lap IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_pit_related
    FROM race_positions rp
    LEFT JOIN pit_stop_laps ps 
        ON rp.race_id = ps.race_id 
        AND rp.driver_id = ps.driver_id 
        AND rp.lap = ps.pit_lap
    WHERE rp.prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT driver_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overtakes_made,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overtaken_count
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE is_pit_related = 0
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname,
       ds.overtakes_made, ds.overtaken_count,
       ds.overtaken_count - ds.overtakes_made as diff
FROM driver_stats ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE ds.overtaken_count > ds.overtakes_made
ORDER BY diff DESC, ds.driver_id

-- Use a nested CTE approach - first categorize, then count
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id,
    CAST(birth_date AS DATE) as birth_date_cast,
    date_diff('year', CAST(birth_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) as age_years
  FROM mst_users

categorized AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    age_years,
    CASE 
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category
  FROM user_ages
)
SELECT 
  age_category,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM categorized
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3

WITH distinct_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT stamp, session, action, option, path, search_type
    FROM activity_log
),
session_first_conversion AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_conversion_stamp
    FROM distinct_activity
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete', '/complete/')
    GROUP BY session
),
session_pre_events AS (
    SELECT 
        sfc.session,
        da.path,
        da.search_type
    FROM session_first_conversion sfc
    JOIN distinct_activity da ON da.session = sfc.session AND da.stamp < sfc.first_conversion_stamp
    WHERE da.search_type != ''
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        sfc.session,
        COUNT(spe.path) AS pre_event_count
    FROM session_first_conversion sfc
    LEFT JOIN session_pre_events spe ON spe.session = sfc.session
    GROUP BY sfc.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) AS min_count
    FROM session_counts
)
SELECT sc.session, 
       spe.path, 
       spe.search_type
FROM session_counts sc
CROSS JOIN min_count mc
LEFT JOIN session_pre_events spe ON spe.session = sc.session
WHERE sc.pre_event_count = mc.min_count
ORDER BY sc.session

-- One row per qualifying session with path and search_type
WITH first_conversion AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_conv_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path = '/complete'
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_counts AS (
    SELECT al.session, COUNT(*) as pre_event_count
    FROM activity_log al
    JOIN first_conversion fc ON al.session = fc.session
    WHERE al.stamp < fc.first_conv_stamp
    AND al.search_type <> ''
    GROUP BY al.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) as min_count FROM pre_counts
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
    SELECT pc.session
    FROM pre_counts pc, min_count mc
    WHERE pc.pre_event_count = mc.min_count
),
first_pre_event AS (
    SELECT al.session, al.path, al.search_type,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY al.session ORDER BY al.stamp, al.path) as rn
    FROM activity_log al
    JOIN first_conversion fc ON al.session = fc.session
    WHERE al.stamp < fc.first_conv_stamp
    AND al.search_type <> ''
)
SELECT q.session, fp.path, fp.search_type
FROM qualifying_sessions q
JOIN first_pre_event fp ON q.session = fp.session AND fp.rn = 1

WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, path, search_type FROM activity_log
),
first_conversion AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_conversion_stamp
  FROM deduped
  WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
  GROUP BY session
),
first_conversion_event AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.session, d.path, d.search_type
  FROM deduped d
  JOIN first_conversion fc ON d.session = fc.session
  WHERE d.stamp = fc.first_conversion_stamp
),
session_counts AS (
  SELECT fc.session, COUNT(d.search_type) as event_count
  FROM first_conversion fc
  LEFT JOIN deduped d ON d.session = fc.session AND d.stamp < fc.first_conversion_stamp AND d.search_type != ''
  GROUP BY fc.session
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(event_count) as min_count
  FROM session_counts
),
first_event_per_session AS (
  SELECT session, path, search_type
  FROM (
    SELECT session, path, search_type,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY path) as rn
    FROM first_conversion_event
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
  SELECT session, event_count
  FROM session_counts
  WHERE event_count = (SELECT min_count FROM min_count)
)
SELECT qs.session, qs.event_count, fes.path, fes.search_type
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN first_event_per_session fes ON qs.session = fes.session
ORDER BY qs.session

-- Final solution:
-- 1. Find sessions with first /detail or /complete
-- 2. Count events before that with non-empty search_type
-- 3. Find minimum count
-- 4. Return qualifying sessions with their pre-conversion events (path, search_type)

WITH distinct_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, action, option, path, search_type 
    FROM activity_log
),
first_conversion AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_conv
    FROM distinct_events
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        fc.session,
        COUNT(*) as pre_conversion_count
    FROM first_conversion fc
    JOIN distinct_events de ON de.session = fc.session
    WHERE de.stamp < fc.first_conv
      AND de.search_type != ''
    GROUP BY fc.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_conversion_count) as min_cnt FROM session_counts
)
SELECT 
    sc.session,
    de.path,
    de.search_type
FROM session_counts sc
JOIN min_count mc ON sc.pre_conversion_count = mc.min_cnt
JOIN distinct_events de ON de.session = sc.session
JOIN first_conversion fc ON fc.session = sc.session
WHERE de.stamp < fc.first_conv
  AND de.search_type != ''
ORDER BY sc.session, de.stamp, de.path

-- Check all sessions and their counts
WITH distinct_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, action, option, path, search_type
    FROM activity_log
),
first_trigger AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_trigger_stamp
    FROM distinct_events
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_trigger_events AS (
    SELECT de.session, de.stamp, de.path, de.search_type
    FROM distinct_events de
    LEFT JOIN first_trigger ft ON de.session = ft.session
    WHERE de.search_type <> ''
      AND (
          ft.first_trigger_stamp IS NULL 
          OR de.stamp < ft.first_trigger_stamp
      )
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT session, COUNT(*) as pre_trigger_count
    FROM pre_trigger_events
    GROUP BY session
),
all_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session FROM distinct_events
),
session_counts_full AS (
    SELECT a.session, COALESCE(sc.pre_trigger_count, 0) as pre_trigger_count
    FROM all_sessions a
    LEFT JOIN session_counts sc ON a.session = sc.session
)
SELECT * FROM session_counts_full ORDER BY pre_trigger_count, session

-- Final query: return qualifying sessions with their path and search_type of first pre-click event
WITH distinct_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, action, option, path, search_type 
  FROM activity_log
),
first_detail_complete AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_detail_stamp
  FROM distinct_events
  WHERE path = '/detail' OR path = '/detail/' OR path = '/complete'
  GROUP BY session
),
pre_events AS (
  SELECT de.session, de.stamp, de.path, de.search_type
  FROM distinct_events de
  JOIN first_detail_complete fdc ON de.session = fdc.session
  WHERE de.stamp < fdc.first_detail_stamp
    AND de.search_type <> ''
),
session_counts AS (
  SELECT session, COUNT(*) as pre_click_count
  FROM pre_events
  GROUP BY session
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_cnt
  FROM session_counts
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
  SELECT sc.session, sc.pre_click_count
  FROM session_counts sc, min_count mc
  WHERE sc.pre_click_count = mc.min_cnt
),
first_pre_event AS (
  SELECT session, path, search_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) as rn
  FROM pre_events
  WHERE session IN (SELECT session FROM qualifying_sessions)
)
SELECT qs.session, qs.pre_click_count, fpe.path, fpe.search_type
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN first_pre_event fpe ON qs.session = fpe.session AND fpe.rn = 1
ORDER BY qs.session
